units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|There is nothing here. Only unceasing desolation. The slow churning of hateful ice that swallowed the dream of a world. Yet, here you are. You've landed along the equator, where the environment is not quite so hostile, and where patches of unconquered ice-free rock still reign.|10845|0
units.english: There is nothing here. Only unceasing desolation. The slow churning of hateful ice that swallowed the dream of a world. Yet, here you are. You've landed along the equator, where the environment is not quite so hostile, and where patches of unconquered ice-free rock still reign.
units.italian: Non c'è nulla qui. Solo una desolazione senza fine. Il lento agitarsi del ghiaccio ostile che ha inghiottito il sogno di un mondo. Eppure eccoti qui. Sei atterrato lungo l'equatore, dove l'ambiente non è così ostile e dove regnano ancora lembi di roccia non conquistata dal ghiaccio.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Beyond your ship are the ruins of the last unfrozen city. Where the final refugees huddled together awaiting their saviors, the Republic Navy, and were whisked away to other more welcoming worlds.|10846|0
units.english: Beyond your ship are the ruins of the last unfrozen city. Where the final refugees huddled together awaiting their saviors, the Republic Navy, and were whisked away to other more welcoming worlds.
units.italian: Oltre la tua nave ci sono le rovine dell'ultima città non congelata. Dove gli ultimi profughi si sono accalcati in attesa dei loro salvatori, la Marina della Repubblica, e sono stati portati via verso altri mondi più accoglienti.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Explore the area.)|10848|0
units.english: (Explore the area.)
units.italian: (Esplora la zona.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Leave this world.)|10850|0
units.english: (Leave this world.)
units.italian: (Lascia questo mondo.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	There is nothing here anyone could want. You leave this abandoned world to its glaciers and ghosts.|10851|0
units.english: There is nothing here anyone could want. You leave this abandoned world to its glaciers and ghosts.
units.italian: Non c'è nulla qui che qualcuno possa volere. Lasci questo mondo abbandonato ai suoi ghiacciai e ai suoi fantasmi.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You break out the cold gear and dress yourself in warm layers with sturdy boots. Furtive frost cracks and breaks as your ship's door opens, and you step out into the cold air. This world's dim light reflects painfully off the ice and snow, momentarily blinding you.|10855|0
units.english: You break out the cold gear and dress yourself in warm layers with sturdy boots. Furtive frost cracks and breaks as your ship's door opens, and you step out into the cold air. This world's dim light reflects painfully off the ice and snow, momentarily blinding you.
units.italian: Tiri fuori l'attrezzatura da freddo e ti vesti a strati caldi con stivali robusti. Il gelo furtivo scricchiola e si spezza mentre la porta della nave si apre, e metti piede nell'aria fredda. La luce fioca di questo mondo si riflette dolorosamente sul ghiaccio e sulla neve, accecandoti per un momento.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Once outside in the sharp, crisp air it's easy to find the dismal ruins of this world's last spaceport. The trek is slow and clumsy in the unfamiliar gravity and granular snow.|10856|0
units.english: Once outside in the sharp, crisp air it's easy to find the dismal ruins of this world's last spaceport. The trek is slow and clumsy in the unfamiliar gravity and granular snow.
units.italian: Una volta fuori, nell'aria frizzante e tagliente, è facile trovare le rovine desolate dell'ultimo spazioporto di questo mondo. Il cammino è lento e impacciato nella gravità inconsueta e nella neve granulosa.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You work around the silent spaceport, where the half-buried hangars are littered with the forgotten mementos of desperate refugees, and many of the buildings are lost beneath the encroaching ice. Eventually you see a cliff edge with dozens of cairns piled along it. Silent watchers of the churning glaciers.|10857|0
units.english: You work around the silent spaceport, where the half-buried hangars are littered with the forgotten mementos of desperate refugees, and many of the buildings are lost beneath the encroaching ice. Eventually you see a cliff edge with dozens of cairns piled along it. Silent watchers of the churning glaciers.
units.italian: Ti muovi intorno allo spazioporto silenzioso, dove gli hangar semisepolti sono sparsi di ricordi dimenticati di profughi disperati, e molti edifici sono perduti sotto il ghiaccio che avanza. Alla fine vedi il bordo di una scogliera con dozzine di cairn ammucchiati lungo di essa. Silenziosi guardiani dei ghiacciai in movimento.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	The sun begins to set, and you can already feel the temperature beginning to plummet. There's not much else to see in this abandoned world, and it may be time to head back.|10858|0
units.english: The sun begins to set, and you can already feel the temperature beginning to plummet. There's not much else to see in this abandoned world, and it may be time to head back.
units.italian: Il sole comincia a tramontare, e senti già la temperatura che sta per precipitare. Non c'è molto altro da vedere in questo mondo abbandonato, e forse è ora di tornare.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Search for the Snaiwaz Family-Cairn.)|10865|0
units.english: (Search for the Snaiwaz Family-Cairn.)
units.italian: (Cerca il Family-Cairn degli Snaiwaz.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Toss the stone out of the hatch and leave this world.)|10867|0
units.english: (Toss the stone out of the hatch and leave this world.)
units.italian: (Butta la pietra fuori dal portello e lascia questo mondo.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	The stone of Tosti's father tumbles out of the ship and comes to rest in a heap of cluttered refuse. This is as close as it will get to its Family-Cairn, and far closer than Tosti could have gotten it on his own.|10871|0
units.english: The stone of Tosti's father tumbles out of the ship and comes to rest in a heap of cluttered refuse. This is as close as it will get to its Family-Cairn, and far closer than Tosti could have gotten it on his own.
units.italian: La pietra del padre di Tosti rotola fuori dalla nave e si ferma in un mucchio di rifiuti alla rinfusa. È il più vicino che arriverà mai al suo Family-Cairn, e molto più vicino di quanto Tosti avrebbe potuto portarla da solo.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|label|10874|0
units.english: cairn search
units.italian: cairn search

Alla fine trovi le scogliere di cui parlava Tosti, e le molte dozzine di Family-Cairn ammucchiati lungo di esse. Silenziosi guardiani dei ghiacciai in movimento.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You see a nearly toppled Family-Cairn with the name "Snaiwaz" at its base.|10878|0
units.english: You see a nearly toppled Family-Cairn with the name "Snaiwaz" at its base.
units.italian: Vedi un Family-Cairn quasi rovesciato con il nome "Snaiwaz" alla base.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Place Tosti's father's stone.)|10880|0
units.english: (Place Tosti's father's stone.)
units.italian: (Deponi la pietra del padre di Tosti.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Throw the stone off the side of the cliff.)|10882|0
units.english: (Throw the stone off the side of the cliff.)
units.italian: (Getta la pietra oltre il bordo della scogliera.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You hurl the stone far beyond the cliff side and down into glacial slopes beneath it, forever separated from its kindred-stones.|10886|0
units.english: You hurl the stone far beyond the cliff side and down into glacial slopes beneath it, forever separated from its kindred-stones.
units.italian: Scagli la pietra ben oltre il bordo della scogliera, giù nei pendii glaciali sottostanti, per sempre separata dalle pietre della sua stirpe.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|label|10889|0
units.english: place stone
units.italian: place stone

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Carefully you place Tosti's stone with the others. The act is greeted only by the deafening silence and the icy air of the abandoned world.|10892|0
units.english: Carefully you place Tosti's stone with the others. The act is greeted only by the deafening silence and the icy air of the abandoned world.
units.italian: Con cura deponi la pietra di Tosti insieme alle altre. Il gesto è accolto solo dal silenzio assordante e dall'aria gelida del mondo abbandonato.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	The sun is setting and your task here is done. You start making your way back through ice and ruin to your ship.|10893|0
units.english: The sun is setting and your task here is done. You start making your way back through ice and ruin to your ship.
units.italian: Il sole sta tramontando e il tuo compito qui è finito. Cominci a tornare indietro fra ghiaccio e rovine verso la nave.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	As you pass around one corner of the sagging spaceport, you notice a large, ice-free building in the distance with a light burning within.|10896|0
units.english: As you pass around one corner of the sagging spaceport, you notice a large, ice-free building in the distance with a light burning within.
units.italian: Mentre giri intorno a un angolo dello spazioporto incurvato, noti in lontananza un grande edificio libero dal ghiaccio con una luce accesa all'interno.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Enter the building.)|10898|0
units.english: (Enter the building.)
units.italian: (Entra nell'edificio.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Keep heading toward my ship.)|10900|0
units.english: (Keep heading toward my ship.)
units.italian: (Continua verso la mia nave.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Whatever is going on in that building, it has nothing to do with you, and so you ignore it and return to your waiting ship.|10902|0
units.english: Whatever is going on in that building, it has nothing to do with you, and so you ignore it and return to your waiting ship.
units.italian: Qualunque cosa stia succedendo in quell'edificio, non ti riguarda, così la ignori e torni alla nave che ti aspetta.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|label|10905|0
units.english: lit building
units.italian: lit building

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You enter into the sturdy and unfrozen building at the edge of the spaceport.|10906|0
units.english: You enter into the sturdy and unfrozen building at the edge of the spaceport.
units.italian: Entri nel robusto edificio non congelato al margine dello spazioporto.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Faded wealth still clings to peeling walls of this once spacious manor. It is evident that it was once the heart and hearth of a wealthy family in an earlier, warmer time. The home feels like a tomb or a museum; it seems as if everything here has been left in a certain way for a long time. But as you work deeper into its nested walls you begin to see signs of much more recent life.|10907|0
units.english: Faded wealth still clings to peeling walls of this once spacious manor. It is evident that it was once the heart and hearth of a wealthy family in an earlier, warmer time. The home feels like a tomb or a museum; it seems as if everything here has been left in a certain way for a long time. But as you work deeper into its nested walls you begin to see signs of much more recent life.
units.italian: Una ricchezza sbiadita si aggrappa ancora alle pareti scrostate di questa villa un tempo spaziosa. È evidente che un tempo era il cuore e il focolare di una famiglia benestante, in un'epoca precedente e più calda. La casa sembra una tomba o un museo: pare che tutto qui sia stato lasciato in un certo modo per molto tempo. Ma addentrandoti fra le sue mura annidate cominci a vedere segni di vita molto più recente.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Eventually you find your way to the kitchen, which appears to be the epicenter of activity in this household. You see assorted survival rations and gear strewn about everywhere. More alarmingly, you also see a young woman sitting on the floor with her back against a counter.|10908|0
units.english: Eventually you find your way to the kitchen, which appears to be the epicenter of activity in this household. You see assorted survival rations and gear strewn about everywhere. More alarmingly, you also see a young woman sitting on the floor with her back against a counter.
units.italian: Alla fine arrivi in cucina, che sembra l'epicentro dell'attività di questa casa. Vedi razioni di sopravvivenza e attrezzature sparse ovunque. Più allarmante, vedi anche una giovane donna seduta a terra con la schiena contro un bancone.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Who are you?"|10910|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Are you okay?"|10911|0
units.english: "Are you okay?"
units.italian: "Stai bene?"

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"What are you doing here?"|10912|0
units.english: "What are you doing here?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ci fai qui?"

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	The woman has short jet black hair. She's wearing a military grade, all-purpose survival suit, the kind you might see on deeply embedded special forces. The only weapon on her is a decorated knife at her belt. She looks pale and frail, probably malnourished. But her icy eyes are clear, and she locks them onto you.|10914|0
units.english: The woman has short jet black hair. She's wearing a military grade, all-purpose survival suit, the kind you might see on deeply embedded special forces. The only weapon on her is a decorated knife at her belt. She looks pale and frail, probably malnourished. But her icy eyes are clear, and she locks them onto you.
units.italian: La donna ha i capelli corti, nerissimi. Indossa una tuta di sopravvivenza militare multiuso, del tipo che si vede addosso alle forze speciali più infiltrate. La sua unica arma è un coltello decorato alla cintura. Sembra pallida e fragile, probabilmente denutrita. Ma i suoi occhi di ghiaccio sono limpidi, e li fissa su di te.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"You come into my home, and expect me to answer your questions?" Her voice is steady.|10915|0
units.english: "You come into my home, and expect me to answer your questions?" Her voice is steady.
units.italian: "Entri in casa mia e ti aspetti che risponda alle tue domande?" La voce è ferma.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Slowly, awkwardly, she pulls herself to her feet, keeping one hand on the counter for balance. She rests her other hand over her knife.|10916|0
units.english: Slowly, awkwardly, she pulls herself to her feet, keeping one hand on the counter for balance. She rests her other hand over her knife.
units.italian: Lentamente, goffamente, si tira in piedi, tenendo una mano sul bancone per equilibrio. L'altra mano resta sopra il coltello.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"You are lucky that you did not barge in here a year ago, or even a month ago." Despite her bravado there is a deep wariness behind her words. "Now tell me, who are you, and what are you doing here?" she asks, through gritted teeth.|10917|0
units.english: "You are lucky that you did not barge in here a year ago, or even a month ago." Despite her bravado there is a deep wariness behind her words. "Now tell me, who are you, and what are you doing here?" she asks, through gritted teeth.
units.italian: "Sei fortunato a non essere piombato qui un anno fa, o anche solo un mese fa." Nonostante la spavalderia, dietro le sue parole c'è una profonda diffidenza. "Ora dimmi, chi sei e che cosa ci fai qui?" chiede, a denti stretti.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Tell her who I am, and how I was just delivering a stone.)|10919|0
units.english: (Tell her who I am, and how I was just delivering a stone.)
units.italian: (Dille chi sono, e che stavo solo consegnando una pietra.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Tell her who I am, and how I was just out exploring.)|10922|0
units.english: (Tell her who I am, and how I was just out exploring.)
units.italian: (Dille chi sono, e che stavo solo esplorando.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	(Tell her it's none of her business.)|10923|0
units.english: (Tell her it's none of her business.)
units.italian: (Dille che non sono affari suoi.)

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	The woman nods slowly, and then painfully, slides back down to the ground.|10925|0
units.english: The woman nods slowly, and then painfully, slides back down to the ground.
units.italian: La donna annuisce lentamente, poi scivola dolorosamente di nuovo a terra.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Her eyes fall to the floor. "I have no choice but to trust you. I have lived here all my life, but my equipment has failed. I never wanted to leave, I was never meant to leave, but I won't let the ice win. I won't let it take me, too."|10926|0
units.english: Her eyes fall to the floor. "I have no choice but to trust you. I have lived here all my life, but my equipment has failed. I never wanted to leave, I was never meant to leave, but I won't let the ice win. I won't let it take me, too."
units.italian: Gli occhi le cadono sul pavimento. "Non ho altra scelta che fidarmi di te. Ho vissuto qui tutta la vita, ma la mia attrezzatura ha ceduto. Non ho mai voluto andarmene, non ero destinata ad andarmene, ma non lascerò vincere il ghiaccio. Non lascerò che prenda anche me."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	She looks back up at you with her piercing eyes. "I am Ildico, last of House Drifa, daughter of Deoric, once one of the most powerful men on Hope. Everyone fled the ice. The Republic Navy made it easy. Enter their ships and be shipped off to paradise, to live as nobodies at the sufferance of strangers.|10927|0
units.english: She looks back up at you with her piercing eyes. "I am Ildico, last of House Drifa, daughter of Deoric, once one of the most powerful men on Hope. Everyone fled the ice. The Republic Navy made it easy. Enter their ships and be shipped off to paradise, to live as nobodies at the sufferance of strangers.
units.italian: Alza di nuovo lo sguardo su di te con i suoi occhi penetranti. "Sono Ildico, ultima della Casa Drifa, figlia di Deoric, un tempo uno degli uomini più potenti su Hope. Tutti sono fuggiti dal ghiaccio. La Marina della Repubblica ha reso tutto facile. Sali sulle loro navi e vieni spedito in paradiso, a vivere come nessuno, per concessione di estranei.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"But we were House Drifa. More than anyone else we built this world, and we would not abandon it to be someone else's dredges. My father bought supplies, equipment, necessities from the Navy. Enough so that me, my brother, and my mother could survive here."|10928|0
units.english: "But we were House Drifa. More than anyone else we built this world, and we would not abandon it to be someone else's dredges. My father bought supplies, equipment, necessities from the Navy. Enough so that me, my brother, and my mother could survive here."
units.italian: "Ma noi eravamo la Casa Drifa. Più di chiunque altro abbiamo costruito questo mondo, e non l'avremmo abbandonato per diventare la feccia di qualcun altro. Mio padre ha comprato provviste, attrezzature, il necessario dalla Marina. Abbastanza perché io, mio fratello e mia madre potessimo sopravvivere qui."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	She pauses, as though unsure she wants to continue; then finally, in a less firm voice: "And then my father left. He said that dozens of worlds, worse off than ours, were terraformed every day. He said all they needed was a little convincing, and that he would come back with the support to terraform, and save, Hope. And then... he never came back."|10929|0
units.english: She pauses, as though unsure she wants to continue; then finally, in a less firm voice: "And then my father left. He said that dozens of worlds, worse off than ours, were terraformed every day. He said all they needed was a little convincing, and that he would come back with the support to terraform, and save, Hope. And then... he never came back."
units.italian: Si ferma, come se non fosse sicura di voler continuare; poi finalmente, con voce meno ferma: "E poi mio padre se n'è andato. Diceva che dozzine di mondi, messi peggio del nostro, venivano terraformati ogni giorno. Diceva che bastava un po' di convincimento, e che sarebbe tornato con il sostegno per terraformare e salvare Hope. E poi... non è mai tornato."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Ildico sighs. "A treasure hunter killed my brother a few years back. My mother... she is also dead, and I am starving. I have no way to contact anyone else, and no one else is left.|10930|0
units.english: Ildico sighs. "A treasure hunter killed my brother a few years back. My mother... she is also dead, and I am starving. I have no way to contact anyone else, and no one else is left.
units.italian: Ildico sospira. "Un cacciatore di tesori ha ucciso mio fratello qualche anno fa. Mia madre... anche lei è morta, e io sto morendo di fame. Non ho modo di contattare nessun altro, e non è rimasto nessuno.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"So, what do you say," she says while leaning her head back, clearly exhausted by this exchange. "Will you kill me? Take advantage of me? Save me? Or leave me... to die?"|10931|0
units.english: "So, what do you say," she says while leaning her head back, clearly exhausted by this exchange. "Will you kill me? Take advantage of me? Save me? Or leave me... to die?"
units.italian: "Allora, che dici," dice appoggiando la testa all'indietro, chiaramente esausta da questo scambio. "Mi ucciderai? Approfitterai di me? Mi salverai? O mi lascerai... morire?"

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Come with me. It's time you gave up on Hope."|10933|0
units.english: "Come with me. It's time you gave up on Hope."
units.italian: "Vieni con me. È tempo che tu rinunci a Hope."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"I'll get you out of here. After that, no promises."|10935|0
units.english: "I'll get you out of here. After that, no promises."
units.italian: "Ti porto fuori di qui. Dopo, nessuna promessa."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"I don't have time for wretches. You're on your own."|10937|0
units.english: "I don't have time for wretches. You're on your own."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per i disperati. Arrangiati."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Ildico, her eyes still closed, takes a deep breath. She opens her eyes just as she lunges at you, with a swift arm motion toward your head. Before you have a chance to react, her knife is embedded deep in your throat.|10938|0
units.english: Ildico, her eyes still closed, takes a deep breath. She opens her eyes just as she lunges at you, with a swift arm motion toward your head. Before you have a chance to react, her knife is embedded deep in your throat.
units.italian: Ildico, con gli occhi ancora chiusi, prende un respiro profondo. Li apre proprio mentre si lancia su di te, con un rapido movimento del braccio verso la tua testa. Prima che tu possa reagire, il suo coltello è conficcato in profondità nella tua gola.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You're on the ground now, with ruby red blood oozing out over the cold floor. You hear a strange moan escaping from your mouth, and Ildico's hands are in your pockets removing everything you have of value.|10939|0
units.english: You're on the ground now, with ruby red blood oozing out over the cold floor. You hear a strange moan escaping from your mouth, and Ildico's hands are in your pockets removing everything you have of value.
units.italian: Ora sei a terra, con sangue rosso rubino che cola sul pavimento freddo. Senti uno strano gemito uscirti dalla bocca, e le mani di Ildico sono nelle tue tasche a portarti via tutto ciò che hai di valore.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	As the world fades to black, you hear her talking, her words sound as though they are coming from a great distance. "Like I said, I won't die here. Thanks for the ship."|10940|0
units.english: As the world fades to black, you hear her talking, her words sound as though they are coming from a great distance. "Like I said, I won't die here. Thanks for the ship."
units.italian: Mentre il mondo si fa nero, la senti parlare, e le sue parole sembrano venire da molto lontano. "Come dicevo, non morirò qui. Grazie per la nave."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Your vision grows darker until only a single point of light remains. You don't feel cold, or pain, or anything at all. You just feel heavy. So heavy. Too heavy. So, you let go.|10941|0
units.english: Your vision grows darker until only a single point of light remains. You don't feel cold, or pain, or anything at all. You just feel heavy. So heavy. Too heavy. So, you let go.
units.italian: La vista si fa più scura finché non resta che un solo punto di luce. Non senti freddo, né dolore, né nulla. Senti solo di pesare. Così pesante. Troppo pesante. E allora ti lasci andare.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|label|10944|0
units.english: come with me
units.italian: come with me

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	You help her back onto her feet, and with her leaning on you, the two of you make your way back outside and through the perilous cold to your ship.|10945|0
units.english: You help her back onto her feet, and with her leaning on you, the two of you make your way back outside and through the perilous cold to your ship.
units.italian: L'aiuti a rimettersi in piedi, e con lei appoggiata a te vi fate strada fuori e attraverso il freddo pericoloso fino alla nave.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Once aboard, after she's eaten and regained a little of her strength, she comes to talk with you.|10946|0
units.english: Once aboard, after she's eaten and regained a little of her strength, she comes to talk with you.
units.italian: Una volta a bordo, dopo che ha mangiato e ha recuperato un po' di forze, viene a parlarti.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Thank you for saving me. There are places I need to go. But I know I cannot force you to take me. And I have no credits to pay you. If you could take me to <planet>, I could make my own way from there."|10947|0
units.english: "Thank you for saving me. There are places I need to go. But I know I cannot force you to take me. And I have no credits to pay you. If you could take me to <planet>, I could make my own way from there."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi salvata. Ci sono posti dove devo andare. Ma so che non posso obbligarti a portarmi. E non ho crediti per pagarti. Se potessi portarmi su <planet>, da lì potrei arrangiarmi."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Anywhere you need to go, I can take you."|10949|0
units.english: "Anywhere you need to go, I can take you."
units.italian: "Dove devi andare, ti ci porto."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"Okay, I'll take you to <planet>, but after that you're on your own."|10951|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take you to <planet>, but after that you're on your own."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su <planet>, ma dopo te la cavi da sola."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|label|10954|0
units.english: where she needs to go
units.italian: where she needs to go

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Ildico narrows her eyes. "Nothing is free."|10955|0
units.english: Ildico narrows her eyes. "Nothing is free."
units.italian: Ildico socchiude gli occhi. "Niente è gratis."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"I just want to make the universe a better place."|10957|0
units.english: "I just want to make the universe a better place."
units.italian: "Voglio solo rendere l'universo un posto migliore."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"It's karma. What goes around comes around."|10958|0
units.english: "It's karma. What goes around comes around."
units.italian: "È karma. Quello che va, torna."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"One day you'll be able to pay me back."|10959|0
units.english: "One day you'll be able to pay me back."
units.italian: "Un giorno potrai ricambiarmi."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"It's how they do things on Norn."|10960|0
units.english: "It's how they do things on Norn."
units.italian: "È come fanno su Norn."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	"My reasons are my own."|10963|0
units.english: "My reasons are my own."
units.italian: "Le mie ragioni sono mie."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	Ildico doesn't react for a moment, seemingly taking in your words.|10967|0
units.english: Ildico doesn't react for a moment, seemingly taking in your words.
units.italian: Ildico non reagisce per un momento, sembra assorbire le tue parole.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	At length she nods slowly. "We'll see."|10968|0
units.english: At length she nods slowly. "We'll see."
units.italian: Alla fine annuisce lentamente. "Vedremo."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen|	She pauses again and then shrugs. "It's not like I have anything to lose... very well. I need to discover what happened to my father. I know he first went to Clark to meet with a terraforming firm there. That's where I start my search."|10969|0
units.english: She pauses again and then shrugs. "It's not like I have anything to lose... very well. I need to discover what happened to my father. I know he first went to Clark to meet with a terraforming firm there. That's where I start my search."
units.italian: Si ferma di nuovo, poi fa spallucce. "Non è che abbia qualcosa da perdere... va bene. Devo scoprire che cosa è successo a mio padre. So che è andato prima su Clark a incontrare una ditta di terraformazione. È da lì che comincio la ricerca."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|Your thrusters kick up fresh dust as you land on your assigned concrete pad in the sprawling spaceport. Ildico, looking less pale and significantly more sturdy, waits by the exit.|10975|0
units.english: Your thrusters kick up fresh dust as you land on your assigned concrete pad in the sprawling spaceport. Ildico, looking less pale and significantly more sturdy, waits by the exit.
units.italian: I propulsori sollevano polvere fresca mentre atterri sulla piazzola di cemento assegnata nello spazioporto sterminato. Ildico, meno pallida e decisamente più salda, aspetta vicino all'uscita.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|	"Thank you for getting me out of there. After all those years on the ice this place will be no challenge for me. Perhaps someday our paths will cross again. If they do, I will remember this small kindness."|10976|0
units.english: "Thank you for getting me out of there. After all those years on the ice this place will be no challenge for me. Perhaps someday our paths will cross again. If they do, I will remember this small kindness."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi tirata fuori da lì. Dopo tutti quegli anni sul ghiaccio, questo posto non sarà una sfida per me. Forse un giorno le nostre strade si incroceranno di nuovo. Se succederà, ricorderò questa piccola gentilezza."

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|	She gives you a stern nod, and then exits your ship and into the chaos of Clark.|10977|0
units.english: She gives you a stern nod, and then exits your ship and into the chaos of Clark.
units.italian: Ti fa un cenno severo, poi esce dalla nave e si immerge nel caos di Clark.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|label|10980|0
units.english: help ildico
units.italian: help ildico

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|Your thrusters kick up fresh dust as you land on your assigned concrete pad on the fringes of the sprawling spaceport. Ildico, looking less pale and significantly more sturdy, waits by the exit.|10981|0
units.english: Your thrusters kick up fresh dust as you land on your assigned concrete pad on the fringes of the sprawling spaceport. Ildico, looking less pale and significantly more sturdy, waits by the exit.
units.italian: I propulsori sollevano polvere fresca mentre atterri sulla piazzola di cemento assegnata ai margini dello spazioporto sterminato. Ildico, meno pallida e decisamente più salda, aspetta vicino all'uscita.

units.id: conversation:Ice Queen End|	"The terraforming firm is certain to have an office, or booth, in the ramshackle spaceport here. Let's pay them a visit."|10982|0
units.english: "The terraforming firm is certain to have an office, or booth, in the ramshackle spaceport here. Let's pay them a visit."
units.italian: "La ditta di terraformazione avrà di sicuro un ufficio, o un banco, nello spazioporto malmesso qui. Andiamo a farci un giro."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|name|10987|0
units.english: Find Ildico's Father
units.italian: Trova il padre di Ildico

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|description|10988|0
units.english: Look for Ildico's father on <destination>, where he went after he left Clark.
units.italian: Cerca il padre di Ildico su <destination>, dove è andato dopo aver lasciato Clark.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|Pushing through the boomtown hustle and bustle, you and Ildico make your way to a series of kiosks, booths, and hastily constructed offices that serve a variety of needs and functions in the ever-growing world of Clark.|11000|0
units.english: Pushing through the boomtown hustle and bustle, you and Ildico make your way to a series of kiosks, booths, and hastily constructed offices that serve a variety of needs and functions in the ever-growing world of Clark.
units.italian: Facendoti largo fra il trambusto della città in espansione, tu e Ildico arrivate a una serie di chioschi, banchi e uffici costruiti in fretta che servono a varie necessità e funzioni nel mondo in continua crescita di Clark.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Among these you find the offices of "Clark's Third Law Terraformists." Ildico steps in front of you and enters first.|11001|0
units.english: Among these you find the offices of "Clark's Third Law Terraformists." Ildico steps in front of you and enters first.
units.italian: Fra questi trovate gli uffici di "Clark's Third Law Terraformists". Ildico ti passa davanti ed entra per prima.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	An older man with greying hair and a bit of a paunch looks up from his desk. He stands up genially as both of you approach and says, "Howdy friends, I am Eustace Goodfellow, and welcome to our cozy establishment. Do you have need of a little terraforming?" Eustace flashes a wide open smile.|11002|0
units.english: An older man with greying hair and a bit of a paunch looks up from his desk. He stands up genially as both of you approach and says, "Howdy friends, I am Eustace Goodfellow, and welcome to our cozy establishment. Do you have need of a little terraforming?" Eustace flashes a wide open smile.
units.italian: Un uomo anziano dai capelli grigi e un po' di pancia alza lo sguardo dalla scrivania. Si alza affabilmente mentre vi avvicinate entrambi e dice: "Salve amici, sono Eustace Goodfellow, benvenuti nella nostra accogliente attività. Avete bisogno di un po' di terraformazione?" Eustace sfodera un sorriso largo e aperto.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	"Yes. I'd like to terraform the planet Hope." Ildico says flatly.|11003|0
units.english: "Yes. I'd like to terraform the planet Hope." Ildico says flatly.
units.italian: "Sì. Vorrei terraformare il pianeta Hope." dice Ildico, piatta.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	"Well, uh, ma'am. We don't, that is to say, we're not that kind of terraforming firm. We do small jobs. Touch ups. We can't... we can't terraform a world, and I don't..." Eustace looks at both of you carefully before saying, "I don't think you could pay for it either."|11004|0
units.english: "Well, uh, ma'am. We don't, that is to say, we're not that kind of terraforming firm. We do small jobs. Touch ups. We can't... we can't terraform a world, and I don't..." Eustace looks at both of you carefully before saying, "I don't think you could pay for it either."
units.italian: "Beh, ehm, signora. Noi non, cioè, non siamo quel tipo di ditta di terraformazione. Facciamo piccoli lavori. Ritocchi. Non possiamo... non possiamo terraformare un mondo, e non..." Eustace vi guarda entrambi con attenzione prima di dire: "Non credo che potreste nemmeno pagarlo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Ildico leaps over the desk and grabs Eustace by his collar. "Is that what you told my father, Lord of House Drifa? Did you send him away like some misbegotten pauper?"|11005|0
units.english: Ildico leaps over the desk and grabs Eustace by his collar. "Is that what you told my father, Lord of House Drifa? Did you send him away like some misbegotten pauper?"
units.italian: Ildico salta oltre la scrivania e afferra Eustace per il colletto. "È questo che hai detto a mio padre, Lord della Casa Drifa? L'hai mandato via come un mendicante da quattro soldi?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Eustace pales and holds out his hands. "Please, let me go. I meant no insult."|11006|0
units.english: Eustace pales and holds out his hands. "Please, let me go. I meant no insult."
units.italian: Eustace impallidisce e tende le mani. "La prego, mi lasci andare. Non volevo offendere."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	(Don't interfere.)|11008|0
units.english: (Don't interfere.)
units.italian: (Non intervenire.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	(Tell Ildico to calm down.)|11009|0
units.english: (Tell Ildico to calm down.)
units.italian: (Dì a Ildico di calmarsi.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Ildico releases his collar, but remains only inches from his face. "Did Deoric Drifa come here years ago asking to terraform Hope?"|11010|0
units.english: Ildico releases his collar, but remains only inches from his face. "Did Deoric Drifa come here years ago asking to terraform Hope?"
units.italian: Ildico gli lascia il colletto, ma resta a pochi centimetri dal suo viso. "Deoric Drifa è venuto qui anni fa chiedendo di terraformare Hope?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Eustace takes a step back, and nods vigorously. "Yes, yes. I remember him. You don't forget a man like him, or a request like his. He asked about terraforming Hope. As I said earlier, we aren't that kind of firm. I told him he'd have to talk to the Academy of Planetary Sciences on <planet> for that kinda work. And then he left.|11011|0
units.english: Eustace takes a step back, and nods vigorously. "Yes, yes. I remember him. You don't forget a man like him, or a request like his. He asked about terraforming Hope. As I said earlier, we aren't that kind of firm. I told him he'd have to talk to the Academy of Planetary Sciences on <planet> for that kinda work. And then he left.
units.italian: Eustace fa un passo indietro e annuisce vigorosamente. "Sì, sì. Me lo ricordo. Un uomo così non lo dimentichi, né una richiesta come la sua. Ha chiesto della terraformazione di Hope. Come dicevo, non siamo quel tipo di ditta. Gli ho detto che per un lavoro del genere avrebbe dovuto parlare con l'Academy of Planetary Sciences su <planet>. E poi se n'è andato.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	"Please." Eustace says, backing up further. "That's all I know about him. I never saw him again."|11012|0
units.english: "Please." Eustace says, backing up further. "That's all I know about him. I never saw him again."
units.italian: "La prego." dice Eustace, arretrando ancora. "È tutto quello che so di lui. Non l'ho più visto."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	Ildico stares at him for a few more moments, and then turns and passes you on her way to the exit.|11013|0
units.english: Ildico stares at him for a few more moments, and then turns and passes you on her way to the exit.
units.italian: Ildico lo fissa per qualche altro istante, poi si volta e ti passa davanti verso l'uscita.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	She opens the door and nods to you. "We're going to <planet>."|11014|0
units.english: She opens the door and nods to you. "We're going to <planet>."
units.italian: Apre la porta e ti fa un cenno. "Andiamo su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|To some Glory is a testament to human ingenuity, skill, and potential. It is the dream made real, the promise proven true. A world perfectly sculpted to suit the needs, desires, and tastes of humanity. Nothing here is left to chance; every inch carefully, artfully, manifested by man's will.|11019|0
units.english: To some Glory is a testament to human ingenuity, skill, and potential. It is the dream made real, the promise proven true. A world perfectly sculpted to suit the needs, desires, and tastes of humanity. Nothing here is left to chance; every inch carefully, artfully, manifested by man's will.
units.italian: Per alcuni Glory è una testimonianza dell'ingegno, dell'abilità e del potenziale umano. È il sogno diventato reale, la promessa dimostrata vera. Un mondo scolpito alla perfezione per soddisfare i bisogni, i desideri e i gusti dell'umanità. Nulla qui è lasciato al caso; ogni centimetro è manifestato con cura e arte dalla volontà dell'uomo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	And yet, to others, it is grotesque, a mockery of nature. A lie made into a monument. As you deal with the Republic spaceport officials you notice the plastic-perfect denizens walking around, staring at your defective face and your workworn ship.|11020|0
units.english: And yet, to others, it is grotesque, a mockery of nature. A lie made into a monument. As you deal with the Republic spaceport officials you notice the plastic-perfect denizens walking around, staring at your defective face and your workworn ship.
units.italian: Eppure, per altri è grottesco, una parodia della natura. Una bugia trasformata in monumento. Mentre hai a che fare con i funzionari dello spazioporto della Repubblica noti i cittadini di plastica perfetta che camminano intorno, fissando la tua faccia difettosa e la tua nave logorata dal lavoro.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	"There is no beauty here," Ildico says vacantly when you're finished with the officials. "Only vanity."|11021|0
units.english: "There is no beauty here," Ildico says vacantly when you're finished with the officials. "Only vanity."
units.italian: "Qui non c'è bellezza," dice Ildico con voce vuota quando hai finito con i funzionari. "Solo vanità."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 2|	The spaceport's transport terminal has a direct rail link to the Academy of Planetary Sciences. Perhaps you could find out what happened to Ildico's father in the Academy.|11022|0
units.english: The spaceport's transport terminal has a direct rail link to the Academy of Planetary Sciences. Perhaps you could find out what happened to Ildico's father in the Academy.
units.italian: Il terminale dei trasporti dello spazioporto ha un collegamento ferroviario diretto con l'Academy of Planetary Sciences. Forse potresti scoprire all'Accademia che cosa è successo al padre di Ildico.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|name|11026|0
units.english: Find Ildico's Father
units.italian: Trova il padre di Ildico

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|description|11027|0
units.english: Professor McGiven told you that Ildico's father now works for the Republic on <destination>. Bring Ildico there to see if you can visit him.
units.italian: Il professor McGiven ti ha detto che il padre di Ildico ora lavora per la Repubblica su <destination>. Portaci Ildico per vedere se riuscite a fargli visita.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|The Academy of Planetary Sciences is a campus the size of a small nation-state on Earth. Various artificially created and maintained microclimates abound as you travel between miniature mountains and micro-savannahs; between marshland and jungle, desert and forest. Impossible machines - some larger than skyscrapers - litter the twisted and ever-changing landscape, and terraforming satellites make meteor showers overhead in the dawn light. This is a place where anything is possible, and land bends eagerly to the whims of the terraforming wizards.|11035|0
units.english: The Academy of Planetary Sciences is a campus the size of a small nation-state on Earth. Various artificially created and maintained microclimates abound as you travel between miniature mountains and micro-savannahs; between marshland and jungle, desert and forest. Impossible machines - some larger than skyscrapers - litter the twisted and ever-changing landscape, and terraforming satellites make meteor showers overhead in the dawn light. This is a place where anything is possible, and land bends eagerly to the whims of the terraforming wizards.
units.italian: L'Academy of Planetary Sciences è un campus grande quanto un piccolo stato-nazione sulla Terra. Microclimi creati e mantenuti artificialmente abbondano mentre viaggi fra montagne in miniatura e micro-savane, fra paludi e giungla, deserto e foresta. Macchine impossibili, alcune più grandi dei grattacieli, sono sparse nel paesaggio contorto e in continuo mutamento, e i satelliti per la terraformazione producono sciami di meteore nel cielo dell'alba. È un luogo dove tutto è possibile e la terra si piega docile ai capricci dei maghi della terraformazione.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Eventually, Ildico and you make it to the primary reception complex, where after hours of filling out inane forms, and waiting in different meaningless queues, you finally reach someone who can help you. An old visitor list shows that one Deoric Drifa had visited a Professor Ian McGiven, Second Degree Terraformer and World Warming specialist in JZ86 Cantos-B of Cooling Block 9 in the Everest Facility.|11036|0
units.english: Eventually, Ildico and you make it to the primary reception complex, where after hours of filling out inane forms, and waiting in different meaningless queues, you finally reach someone who can help you. An old visitor list shows that one Deoric Drifa had visited a Professor Ian McGiven, Second Degree Terraformer and World Warming specialist in JZ86 Cantos-B of Cooling Block 9 in the Everest Facility.
units.italian: Alla fine tu e Ildico arrivate al complesso principale della reception, dove dopo ore di moduli assurdi e code diverse e senza senso raggiungete finalmente qualcuno che può aiutarvi. Un vecchio elenco dei visitatori mostra che un certo Deoric Drifa aveva fatto visita a un professor Ian McGiven, Terraformatore di Secondo Grado e specialista in riscaldamento planetario, in JZ86 Cantos-B del Cooling Block 9 nell'Everest Facility.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	The receptionist helpfully draws you a map to where you're going. She also lets you know that in order to visit him you'll need to fill out six other forms first. You get to work.|11037|0
units.english: The receptionist helpfully draws you a map to where you're going. She also lets you know that in order to visit him you'll need to fill out six other forms first. You get to work.
units.italian: La receptionist vi disegna gentilmente una mappa del percorso. Vi informa anche che per fargli visita dovrete prima compilare altri sei moduli. Vi mettete al lavoro.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Fill out the forms.)|11039|0
units.english: (Fill out the forms.)
units.italian: (Compila i moduli.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	You input your standard credentials. Full name, date of birth, location of birth, occupation, ID, social and civil information, and signature. You flip the form over, moving to the next.|11040|0
units.english: You input your standard credentials. Full name, date of birth, location of birth, occupation, ID, social and civil information, and signature. You flip the form over, moving to the next.
units.italian: Inserisci le tue credenziali standard. Nome completo, data di nascita, luogo di nascita, professione, documento, informazioni sociali e civili, e firma. Giri il modulo e passi al successivo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Fill out more forms.)|11042|0
units.english: (Fill out more forms.)
units.italian: (Compila altri moduli.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	A page straight out of an entry exam faces you. Accompanied by a set of dots representing if or how often you have caught them, are dozens of labels noting common diseases along with illnesses you thought had been eradicated. The majority of options consist of words and names you imagine must represent some serious conditions, but which you have no recollection of ever reading or hearing about. After scraping your memory as best as you can for your medical history, you eventually finish filling out the last set of dots, and sign. Sighing, you flip the form.|11043|0
units.english: A page straight out of an entry exam faces you. Accompanied by a set of dots representing if or how often you have caught them, are dozens of labels noting common diseases along with illnesses you thought had been eradicated. The majority of options consist of words and names you imagine must represent some serious conditions, but which you have no recollection of ever reading or hearing about. After scraping your memory as best as you can for your medical history, you eventually finish filling out the last set of dots, and sign. Sighing, you flip the form.
units.italian: Ti trovi davanti una pagina presa pari pari da un esame d'ammissione. Accompagnate da una serie di caselle che indicano se e quanto spesso le hai contratte, ci sono dozzine di voci sulle malattie comuni insieme a malattie che credevi eradicata. La maggior parte delle opzioni è fatta di parole e nomi che immagini rappresentino condizioni serie, ma che non ricordi di aver mai letto o sentito. Dopo aver frugato la memoria il meglio possibile per la tua storia medica, finisci di riempire l'ultima serie di caselle e firmi. Sospirando, giri il modulo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Continue filling out forms.)|11045|0
units.english: (Continue filling out forms.)
units.italian: (Continua a compilare moduli.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	You begin to wonder how it was less bureaucratically stressful to purchase your first ship than it is to schedule an encounter with a campus professor here. When the form prompts you for your address, you scramble out of the room to research what spaceship captains should fill out in such cases. After many contradicting forums and blatantly outdated government websites, you return and put in the best answer you can think of. Then the form specifically requires you to input the institution you studied at, here on <origin>. Again you set to look for answers on how to respond when you are not even from the planet this form is from. After a few more questions, you start to zone out and just automatically input whatever seems least likely to get the form rejected, based on online tips and nebulous descriptions from government pages.|11046|0
units.english: You begin to wonder how it was less bureaucratically stressful to purchase your first ship than it is to schedule an encounter with a campus professor here. When the form prompts you for your address, you scramble out of the room to research what spaceship captains should fill out in such cases. After many contradicting forums and blatantly outdated government websites, you return and put in the best answer you can think of. Then the form specifically requires you to input the institution you studied at, here on <origin>. Again you set to look for answers on how to respond when you are not even from the planet this form is from. After a few more questions, you start to zone out and just automatically input whatever seems least likely to get the form rejected, based on online tips and nebulous descriptions from government pages.
units.italian: Cominci a chiederti come sia stato meno stressante, burocraticamente parlando, comprare la tua prima nave che fissare un incontro con un professore di un campus. Quando il modulo chiede il tuo indirizzo, ti precipiti fuori dalla stanza a cercare che cosa debba indicare un capitano di nave in questi casi. Dopo molti forum contraddittori e siti governativi palesemente obsoleti, torni e scrivi la risposta migliore che ti viene in mente. Poi il modulo richiede espressamente l'istituto presso cui hai studiato, qui su <origin>. Ti rimetti a cercare come rispondere quando non sei nemmeno del pianeta da cui proviene questo modulo. Dopo qualche altra domanda cominci a isolarti e a inserire automaticamente ciò che sembra meno probabile che faccia respingere il modulo, in base a consigli online e a descrizioni fumose delle pagine governative.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	The receptionist brings a few of the earlier forms you filled out and helpfully points out a few mistakes for you to fix.|11047|0
units.english: The receptionist brings a few of the earlier forms you filled out and helpfully points out a few mistakes for you to fix.
units.italian: La receptionist porta alcuni dei moduli compilati prima e ti indica gentilmente qualche errore da correggere.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Fix the forms I already filled out.)|11049|0
units.english: (Fix the forms I already filled out.)
units.italian: (Correggi i moduli che ho già compilato.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	As it turns out, your bank account is not compatible with the due process the forms here are a part of. You download an application to open your very own account on one of the local banks, after checking with the receptionist that this one is compatible. After a few more minutes (and a great many attempts at fitting your face in a camera shot for a mandatory facial recognition step) your new bank details are ready and filled in the forms, which you turn over with haste. Surely it must be ending soon.|11050|0
units.english: As it turns out, your bank account is not compatible with the due process the forms here are a part of. You download an application to open your very own account on one of the local banks, after checking with the receptionist that this one is compatible. After a few more minutes (and a great many attempts at fitting your face in a camera shot for a mandatory facial recognition step) your new bank details are ready and filled in the forms, which you turn over with haste. Surely it must be ending soon.
units.italian: A quanto pare il tuo conto bancario non è compatibile con il procedimento di cui questi moduli fanno parte. Scarichi un'applicazione per aprire un conto tutto tuo presso una delle banche locali, dopo aver verificato con la receptionist che sia compatibile. Dopo qualche altro minuto (e moltissimi tentativi di inquadrare la faccia per il riconoscimento facciale obbligatorio) i nuovi dati bancari sono pronti e inseriti nei moduli, che giri in fretta. Di sicuro sta per finire.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Fill out the final set of forms.)|11052|0
units.english: (Fill out the final set of forms.)
units.italian: (Compila l'ultima serie di moduli.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	In this wondrous paradise of terraforming, a true testament to human ingenuity and mastery over nature, you are close to fuming with frustration at the inability of the local machinery to recognize your signature. For the better part of an hour you get to work on every form again, straining your arms as you slowly, carefully imprint your signature again, on every one of them, as identical to each other as you can.|11053|0
units.english: In this wondrous paradise of terraforming, a true testament to human ingenuity and mastery over nature, you are close to fuming with frustration at the inability of the local machinery to recognize your signature. For the better part of an hour you get to work on every form again, straining your arms as you slowly, carefully imprint your signature again, on every one of them, as identical to each other as you can.
units.italian: In questo meraviglioso paradiso della terraformazione, vera testimonianza dell'ingegno umano e del dominio sulla natura, sei sul punto di fumare di frustrazione per l'incapacità delle macchine locali di riconoscere la tua firma. Per quasi un'ora ti rimetti al lavoro su ogni modulo, sforzando le braccia mentre lenta e attenta reimprimi la tua firma su ognuno, il più identica possibile agli altri.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	A few painfully tedious hours after you first arrived, all the right forms have been filled out and you're met by an intern in a small vehicle.|11054|0
units.english: A few painfully tedious hours after you first arrived, all the right forms have been filled out and you're met by an intern in a small vehicle.
units.italian: Qualche ora di strazio noioso dopo il tuo arrivo, tutti i moduli giusti sono compilati e ti accoglie una stagista su un piccolo veicolo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	She glances at her electronic clipboard. "Captain <last>? Lady Drifa? I am here to escort you to the Everest Facility." She opens the door and gestures to you two. "Please climb aboard. I know the confines are quite small, but the E.F. is only a few kilometers away."|11055|0
units.english: She glances at her electronic clipboard. "Captain <last>? Lady Drifa? I am here to escort you to the Everest Facility." She opens the door and gestures to you two. "Please climb aboard. I know the confines are quite small, but the E.F. is only a few kilometers away."
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata alla sua tavoletta elettronica. "Capitano <last>? Lady Drifa? Sono qui per accompagnarvi all'Everest Facility." Apre la porta e vi fa cenno. "Prego, salite. So che lo spazio è piuttosto stretto, ma l'E.F. è a pochi chilometri."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico glares at the young woman suspiciously, then turns to you. "Can we trust her?"|11056|0
units.english: Ildico glares at the young woman suspiciously, then turns to you. "Can we trust her?"
units.italian: Ildico fissa la giovane con sospetto, poi si volta verso di te. "Possiamo fidarci di lei?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	The intern looks confused and a little hurt, but says nothing.|11057|0
units.english: The intern looks confused and a little hurt, but says nothing.
units.italian: La stagista sembra confusa e un po' ferita, ma non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"We can trust her. We're in no danger here."|11059|0
units.english: "We can trust her. We're in no danger here."
units.italian: "Possiamo fidarci. Qui non corriamo pericoli."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"I'll protect you. Don't worry."|11061|0
units.english: "I'll protect you. Don't worry."
units.italian: "Ti proteggerò io. Non preoccuparti."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"We have no choice if you want answers."|11063|0
units.english: "We have no choice if you want answers."
units.italian: "Non abbiamo scelta, se vuoi delle risposte."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico nods and then enters the vehicle and you follow behind her.|11064|0
units.english: Ildico nods and then enters the vehicle and you follow behind her.
units.italian: Ildico annuisce, poi entra nel veicolo e tu la segui.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|label|11067|0
units.english: no danger
units.italian: no danger

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico barks out a laugh. "So naive. We are always in danger. But for answers I will risk it."|11068|0
units.english: Ildico barks out a laugh. "So naive. We are always in danger. But for answers I will risk it."
units.italian: Ildico scoppia in una risata. "Così ingenuo. Siamo sempre in pericolo. Ma per le risposte lo rischierò."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	She carefully checks the inside of the vehicle before carefully climbing in.|11069|0
units.english: She carefully checks the inside of the vehicle before carefully climbing in.
units.italian: Controlla con cura l'interno del veicolo prima di salirci con prudenza.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Follow her in.)|11071|0
units.english: (Follow her in.)
units.italian: (Segui anche me dentro.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico laughs heartily and sheds a couple tears. "You? Protect me?" She wipes her tears as her mirth subsides and her cold intense coutenance reasserts itself.|11075|0
units.english: Ildico laughs heartily and sheds a couple tears. "You? Protect me?" She wipes her tears as her mirth subsides and her cold intense coutenance reasserts itself.
units.italian: Ildico ride di gusto e versa un paio di lacrime. "Tu? Proteggere me?" Si asciuga le lacrime mentre l'ilarità si spegne e la sua espressione fredda e intensa torna a imporsi.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"No, <first>. I will protect you." Her voice is deadly serious. She then inspects the inside of the vehicle carefully and takes a seat. "It seems safe. And I need answers."|11076|0
units.english: "No, <first>. I will protect you." Her voice is deadly serious. She then inspects the inside of the vehicle carefully and takes a seat. "It seems safe. And I need answers."
units.italian: "No, <first>. Ti proteggerò io." La voce è di una serietà mortale. Poi ispeziona con cura l'interno del veicolo e si siede. "Sembra sicuro. E ho bisogno di risposte."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	(Follow her in.)|11078|0
units.english: (Follow her in.)
units.italian: (Segui anche me dentro.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	After a brief ride through the campus you are escorted deeper and deeper into the maze that is the Everest Facility. Another half an hour of hallways, and turns, and stairs and ups and downs, you finally find yourself inside Ian McGiven's office.|11081|0
units.english: After a brief ride through the campus you are escorted deeper and deeper into the maze that is the Everest Facility. Another half an hour of hallways, and turns, and stairs and ups and downs, you finally find yourself inside Ian McGiven's office.
units.italian: Dopo un breve tragitto nel campus vieni condotto sempre più a fondo nel labirinto che è l'Everest Facility. Altri tre quarti d'ora di corridoi, curve, scale e saliscendi, e alla fine ti ritrovi nell'ufficio di Ian McGiven.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	The man hears your inquiry and nods earnestly. "Ah, yes, of course I remember the fellow! What an interesting meeting that was," Ian says from behind his small desk.|11082|0
units.english: The man hears your inquiry and nods earnestly. "Ah, yes, of course I remember the fellow! What an interesting meeting that was," Ian says from behind his small desk.
units.italian: L'uomo ascolta la tua domanda e annuisce con serietà. "Ah, sì, certo che ricordo quel tizio! Che incontro interessante," dice Ian da dietro la sua piccola scrivania.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"Obviously, the details are confidential, but in very broad generalities, he wanted me to warm up a freezing world."|11083|0
units.english: "Obviously, the details are confidential, but in very broad generalities, he wanted me to warm up a freezing world."
units.italian: "Ovviamente i dettagli sono riservati, ma in linee molto generali, voleva che riscaldassi un mondo congelato."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico doesn't blink; on second thought, you're not sure you've ever seen her blink. "Hope. Yes, and could you warm it?"|11084|0
units.english: Ildico doesn't blink; on second thought, you're not sure you've ever seen her blink. "Hope. Yes, and could you warm it?"
units.italian: Ildico non batte ciglio; a pensarci, non sei sicuro di averla mai vista battere ciglio. "Hope. Sì, e potevi riscaldarlo?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ian laughs. "Oh, of course, a job like that would have been quite simple."|11085|0
units.english: Ian laughs. "Oh, of course, a job like that would have been quite simple."
units.italian: Ian ride. "Oh, certo, un lavoro del genere sarebbe stato piuttosto semplice."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"Then why didn't you?" The tension is obvious in Ildico's voice.|11086|0
units.english: "Then why didn't you?" The tension is obvious in Ildico's voice.
units.italian: "Allora perché non l'hai fatto?" La tensione nella voce di Ildico è evidente.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ian shrugs. "Though he could afford it, there were other concerns."|11087|0
units.english: Ian shrugs. "Though he could afford it, there were other concerns."
units.italian: Ian fa spallucce. "Anche se poteva permetterselo, c'erano altre preoccupazioni."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico steps forward and looms over Ian like an angry shadow. It appears that it is taking all of her willpower to keep her from ripping this man apart. "Concerns?"|11088|0
units.english: Ildico steps forward and looms over Ian like an angry shadow. It appears that it is taking all of her willpower to keep her from ripping this man apart. "Concerns?"
units.italian: Ildico fa un passo avanti e torreggia su Ian come un'ombra arrabbiata. Sembra che le serva tutta la sua forza di volontà per non sbranare quest'uomo. "Preoccupazioni?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	"Y-yes. I don't know the specifics. You have to understand, here at the Academy it's not just about money. It's about politics, and power. I am just a Second Degree Terraformer, and after the initial meeting I wasn't privy to the details. But someone, or some government or corporation didn't want it. If you want to know more you'll have to ask him yourself."|11089|0
units.english: "Y-yes. I don't know the specifics. You have to understand, here at the Academy it's not just about money. It's about politics, and power. I am just a Second Degree Terraformer, and after the initial meeting I wasn't privy to the details. But someone, or some government or corporation didn't want it. If you want to know more you'll have to ask him yourself."
units.italian: "S-sì. Non conosco i dettagli. Deve capire, qui all'Accademia non è solo una questione di denaro. È politica, e potere. Io sono solo un Terraformatore di Secondo Grado, e dopo l'incontro iniziale non ero a parte dei dettagli. Ma qualcuno, o qualche governo o corporazione, non lo voleva. Se vuole saperne di più, dovrà chiedere a lui direttamente."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Ildico seems to deflate. "Ask him? Is... is he here?"|11090|0
units.english: Ildico seems to deflate. "Ask him? Is... is he here?"
units.italian: Ildico sembra sgonfiarsi. "Chiedere a lui? È... è qui?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	The terraformer shakes his head. "Oh, no. He doesn't work for the Academy. But after the rejection he went to the heart of the Republic, I assume to find out why. He now works for them. I see his name from time to time. Just head to the Republic's main office for the Department of Migration, which is located on Chiron."|11091|0
units.english: The terraformer shakes his head. "Oh, no. He doesn't work for the Academy. But after the rejection he went to the heart of the Republic, I assume to find out why. He now works for them. I see his name from time to time. Just head to the Republic's main office for the Department of Migration, which is located on Chiron."
units.italian: Il terraformatore scuote la testa. "Oh, no. Non lavora per l'Accademia. Ma dopo il rifiuto è andato al cuore della Repubblica, immagino per scoprire il perché. Ora lavora per loro. Vedo il suo nome ogni tanto. Basta andare all'ufficio principale del Dipartimento per le Migrazioni della Repubblica, che si trova su Chiron."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 3|	Without saying another word, Ildico turns and leaves. You thank Ian for his help and follow her out.|11092|0
units.english: Without saying another word, Ildico turns and leaves. You thank Ian for his help and follow her out.
units.italian: Senza dire un'altra parola, Ildico si volta ed esce. Ringrazi Ian per l'aiuto e la segui fuori.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|It's easy to imagine Earth once looked and felt much like Chiron does today. A vibrant world, full of engaged and motivated people, all in a hurry to change the universe - or at least, to run it.|11106|0
units.english: It's easy to imagine Earth once looked and felt much like Chiron does today. A vibrant world, full of engaged and motivated people, all in a hurry to change the universe - or at least, to run it.
units.italian: È facile immaginare che la Terra un tempo apparisse e si sentisse più o meno come Chiron oggi. Un mondo vibrante, pieno di persone coinvolte e motivate, tutte di fretta per cambiare l'universo, o almeno per amministrarlo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	The Department of Migration, Stellar Populations and Advanced Interplanetary Economics is easy enough to find. What's surprising is how quickly you are ushered into a waiting room outside the office of one Mr. Drifa, Sub-Executive of Multiplanetary Pricing.|11107|0
units.english: The Department of Migration, Stellar Populations and Advanced Interplanetary Economics is easy enough to find. What's surprising is how quickly you are ushered into a waiting room outside the office of one Mr. Drifa, Sub-Executive of Multiplanetary Pricing.
units.italian: Il Dipartimento per le Migrazioni, le Popolazioni Stellari e l'Economia Interplanetaria Avanzata è facile da trovare. Sorprendente è la rapidità con cui vieni introdotto in una sala d'attesa fuori dall'ufficio di un certo signor Drifa, Sotto-Dirigente per i Prezzi Multiplanetari.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	After a brief wait, a young secretary announces that Mr. Drifa is ready to see you, and brings you and Ildico into his office.|11108|0
units.english: After a brief wait, a young secretary announces that Mr. Drifa is ready to see you, and brings you and Ildico into his office.
units.italian: Dopo una breve attesa una giovane segretaria annuncia che il signor Drifa è pronto a ricevervi, e conduce te e Ildico nel suo ufficio.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"So what can I help you with..." Deoric Drifa's voice trails off as he sees Ildico.|11109|0
units.english: "So what can I help you with..." Deoric Drifa's voice trails off as he sees Ildico.
units.italian: "Allora, come posso aiutarla..." La voce di Deoric Drifa si spegne quando vede Ildico.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	Ildico tries to step forward than stops herself. She freezes up.|11110|0
units.english: Ildico tries to step forward than stops herself. She freezes up.
units.italian: Ildico cerca di fare un passo avanti, poi si ferma. Si blocca.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"It can't be," the elder Drifa whispers.|11111|0
units.english: "It can't be," the elder Drifa whispers.
units.italian: "Non è possibile," sussurra il vecchio Drifa.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"Why. Didn't. You. Come?" Ildico forces out each word.|11112|0
units.english: "Why. Didn't. You. Come?" Ildico forces out each word.
units.italian: "Perché. Non. Sei. Venuto?" Ildico forza fuori ogni parola.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"I sent for you. They told me you were all dead. They found bodies... and the generator blown."|11113|0
units.english: "I sent for you. They told me you were all dead. They found bodies... and the generator blown."
units.italian: "Vi ho mandato a chiamare. Mi hanno detto che eravate tutti morti. Hanno trovato dei corpi... e il generatore saltato."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"The accident..." Ildico says more to herself than anyone else. And then in that instant she unfreezes, emotions roil through her, and she runs to her father, with everything forgiven.|11114|0
units.english: "The accident..." Ildico says more to herself than anyone else. And then in that instant she unfreezes, emotions roil through her, and she runs to her father, with everything forgiven.
units.italian: "L'incidente..." dice Ildico più a sé stessa che agli altri. E in quell'istante si sblocca, le emozioni le si rovesciano addosso, e corre dal padre, con ogni cosa perdonata.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	After a long tear-filled embrace she disengages and wipes her eyes. "Early on the generator blew and we had to evacuate the compound. Some people died... including Hogne." She glances at you and says, "He was my older brother."|11115|0
units.english: After a long tear-filled embrace she disengages and wipes her eyes. "Early on the generator blew and we had to evacuate the compound. Some people died... including Hogne." She glances at you and says, "He was my older brother."
units.italian: Dopo un lungo abbraccio pieno di lacrime si stacca e si asciuga gli occhi. "All'inizio il generatore è saltato e abbiamo dovuto evacuare il complesso. Alcuni sono morti... compreso Hogne." Ti lancia un'occhiata e dice: "Era mio fratello maggiore."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	She continues, "I salvaged what I could and set up at home. I've been there the whole time."|11116|0
units.english: She continues, "I salvaged what I could and set up at home. I've been there the whole time."
units.italian: Continua: "Ho recuperato quello che potevo e mi sono sistemata a casa. Sono rimasta lì tutto il tempo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"It's my fault," Deoric says. "I should have gone and looked for you myself. I would have known where to look."|11117|0
units.english: "It's my fault," Deoric says. "I should have gone and looked for you myself. I would have known where to look."
units.italian: "È colpa mia," dice Deoric. "Sarei dovuto andare a cercarvi di persona. Avrei saputo dove guardare."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	They talk about family, the time apart, and what happened back on Hope. Finally, Ildico turns her attention back to you.|11118|0
units.english: They talk about family, the time apart, and what happened back on Hope. Finally, Ildico turns her attention back to you.
units.italian: Parlano della famiglia, del tempo passato lontani e di quello che è successo su Hope. Alla fine Ildico riporta l'attenzione su di te.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"Thank you for bringing me here, <first>. For sticking with me. I appreciate it." She gives you the first real genuine smile you've seen on her face.|11119|0
units.english: "Thank you for bringing me here, <first>. For sticking with me. I appreciate it." She gives you the first real genuine smile you've seen on her face.
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi portata qui, <first>. Per essere rimasto con me. Lo apprezzo." Ti rivolge il primo sorriso davvero sincero che vedi sul suo viso.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"No problem, Ildico."|11121|0
units.english: "No problem, Ildico."
units.italian: "Nessun problema, Ildico."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	"You're welcome, Ildico."|11122|0
units.english: "You're welcome, Ildico."
units.italian: "Figurati, Ildico."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	She looks at you for just a moment, as if in thought, and then says, "If we ever meet again, call me Ildy. It's what my friends call me."|11124|0
units.english: She looks at you for just a moment, as if in thought, and then says, "If we ever meet again, call me Ildy. It's what my friends call me."
units.italian: Ti guarda per un istante, come pensierosa, poi dice: "Se ci incontreremo ancora, chiamami Ildy. È così che mi chiamano gli amici."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 4|	With that you take your leave.|11125|0
units.english: With that you take your leave.
units.italian: Detto questo vi congedate.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|name|11134|0
units.english: Visit Ildico
units.italian: Fare visita a Ildico

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|description|11135|0
units.english: Ildico has asked you to visit her on <destination>.
units.italian: Ildico ti ha chiesto di farle visita su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|Your inbox blinks with a new message from Ildico on Chiron:|11144|0
units.english: Your inbox blinks with a new message from Ildico on Chiron:
units.italian: La tua casella lampeggia con un nuovo messaggio da Ildico su Chiron:

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|	"I need to see you. Please come. My address is attached.|11146|0
units.english: "I need to see you. Please come. My address is attached.
units.italian: "Devo vederti. Ti prego, vieni. Il mio indirizzo è allegato.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|				-your friend|11147|0
units.english: -your friend
units.italian: -la tua amica

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|					Ildy"|11148|0
units.english: Ildy"
units.italian: Ildy"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 5|The myriad lights of urban settlements twinkle in the dusk as you approach the capital, and main spaceport, of Chiron. Crickets, brought from old Earth, chirp in the twilight air. Your ship parked, you'll need to make your way to the main spaceport to hire transportation to Ildico's address.|11152|0
units.english: The myriad lights of urban settlements twinkle in the dusk as you approach the capital, and main spaceport, of Chiron. Crickets, brought from old Earth, chirp in the twilight air. Your ship parked, you'll need to make your way to the main spaceport to hire transportation to Ildico's address.
units.italian: Le miriadi di luci degli insediamenti urbani brillano nel crepuscolo mentre ti avvicini alla capitale, e principale spazioporto, di Chiron. I grilli, portati dalla vecchia Terra, friniscono nell'aria del crepuscolo. Con la nave parcheggiata, dovrai raggiungere lo spazioporto principale per noleggiare un trasporto fino all'indirizzo di Ildico.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|name|11156|0
units.english: Take Ildico to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Ildico su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|description|11157|0
units.english: Smuggle Ildico and her child to <destination>.
units.italian: Fai passare di nascosto Ildico e suo figlio fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|illegal|11161|0
units.english: Ildico Drifa is dragged away in chains for high crimes against the Republic. You can only watch in silence as they are removed from your ship and her infant child is taken into custody. You end up fined for your actions.
units.italian: Ildico Drifa viene trascinata via in catene per alti tradimenti contro la Repubblica. Puoi solo guardare in silenzio mentre la portano via dalla tua nave e suo figlio in fasce viene preso in custodia. Finisci con una multa per le tue azioni.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|The directions Ildico gave you take you beyond the bustling city and out into the large estates owned by the Republic political elite; Drifa Manor sits atop a low hill with what must be a very expensive view of New Sydney. The architecture of the building is reminiscent of upper-class villas you've seen in the Deep.|11168|0
units.english: The directions Ildico gave you take you beyond the bustling city and out into the large estates owned by the Republic political elite; Drifa Manor sits atop a low hill with what must be a very expensive view of New Sydney. The architecture of the building is reminiscent of upper-class villas you've seen in the Deep.
units.italian: Le indicazioni di Ildico ti portano oltre la città brulicante, fuori nelle grandi tenute di proprietà dell'élite politica della Repubblica; Drifa Manor siede in cima a una bassa collina, con quella che dev'essere una vista molto costosa su New Sydney. L'architettura dell'edificio ricorda le ville di classe alta che hai visto nel Deep.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	As you approach the main gate you find it wide open, and the attached security booth is abandoned. You could just walk right in.|11169|0
units.english: As you approach the main gate you find it wide open, and the attached security booth is abandoned. You could just walk right in.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al cancello principale lo trovi spalancato, e la garitta di sicurezza annessa è abbandonata. Potresti semplicemente entrare.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Walk right in.)|11171|0
units.english: (Walk right in.)
units.italian: (Entra pure.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Investigate before entering.)|11173|0
units.english: (Investigate before entering.)
units.italian: (Indaga prima di entrare.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The gate itself appears to have been opened from the inside, not broken into, and there are no signs of a struggle in the security booth. The employee parking beyond is also completely empty. It seems everyone left fast and didn't bother to close the gate behind them. You're entirely alone out here.|11174|0
units.english: The gate itself appears to have been opened from the inside, not broken into, and there are no signs of a struggle in the security booth.
