The employee parking beyond is also completely empty. It seems everyone left fast and didn't bother to close the gate behind them. You're entirely alone out here.
units.italian: Il cancello stesso sembra essere stato aperto dall'interno, non forzato, e nella garitta non ci sono segni di colluttazione. Anche il parcheggio dei dipendenti oltre è completamente vuoto. Sembra che tutti siano andati via in fretta senza preoccuparsi di chiudere il cancello. Sei del tutto solo qui fuori.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Walk right in.)|11176|0
units.english: (Walk right in.)
units.italian: (Entra pure.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Leave.)|11178|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Whatever this is; you decide you aren't interested. Ildico will just have to fend for herself.|11179|0
units.english: Whatever this is; you decide you aren't interested. Ildico will just have to fend for herself.
units.italian: Qualunque cosa sia, decidi che non ti interessa. Ildico dovrà cavarsela da sola.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The spacious building is eerily empty of servants. Doors are left often, incomplete tasks clutter the floor. Whatever happened here, the people left in a hurry.|11183|0
units.english: The spacious building is eerily empty of servants. Doors are left often, incomplete tasks clutter the floor. Whatever happened here, the people left in a hurry.
units.italian: L'edificio spazioso è inquietantemente vuoto di servitori. Le porte sono lasciate aperte, i lavori incompiuti ingombrano il pavimento. Qualunque cosa sia successa qui, la gente è andata via in fretta.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	There's a loud crashing noise in the floor above you. You ascend the central grand staircase following the noise.|11184|0
units.english: There's a loud crashing noise in the floor above you. You ascend the central grand staircase following the noise.
units.italian: C'è un forte rumore di qualcosa che si rompe al piano di sopra. Sali la grande scalinata centrale seguendo il rumore.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	There are streaks of crimson blood across the opulent decor and a pool of it settles in the center of the room. Lavish baroque furniture is stained with the carnage.|11185|0
units.english: There are streaks of crimson blood across the opulent decor and a pool of it settles in the center of the room. Lavish baroque furniture is stained with the carnage.
units.italian: Ci sono strisce di sangue cremisi sull'arredo opulento e una pozza se ne raccoglie al centro della stanza. I lussuosi mobili barocchi sono macchiati dal massacro.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	At the center of it all is a ravaged dead body on the floor, and above it stands a bloody, grinning Ildico.|11186|0
units.english: At the center of it all is a ravaged dead body on the floor, and above it stands a bloody, grinning Ildico.
units.italian: Al centro di tutto c'è un cadavere devastato sul pavimento, e sopra di esso sta una Ildico insanguinata e ghignante.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Ildico, what's going on?"|11188|0
units.english: "Ildico, what's going on?"
units.italian: "Ildico, che cosa sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Are you hurt? Do you need help?"|11189|0
units.english: "Are you hurt? Do you need help?"
units.italian: "Sei ferita? Ti serve aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"What have you done?"|11190|0
units.english: "What have you done?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hai fatto?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Say nothing.)|11191|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She ignores you, her attention focused elsewhere.|11193|0
units.english: She ignores you, her attention focused elsewhere.
units.italian: Ti ignora, con l'attenzione rivolta altrove.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"You thought," Ildico says as she catches her breath, "that you could sell me? That you could give me to this bureaucrat who signed Hope's death warrant?" She kicks the lifeless body at her feet. "That I would be your pawn, your tool, your object in order to gain favor and promotion?"|11194|0
units.english: "You thought," Ildico says as she catches her breath, "that you could sell me? That you could give me to this bureaucrat who signed Hope's death warrant?" She kicks the lifeless body at her feet. "That I would be your pawn, your tool, your object in order to gain favor and promotion?"
units.italian: "Pensavi," dice Ildico riprendendo fiato, "di potermi vendere? Di darmi a questo burocrate che ha firmato la condanna a morte di Hope?" Prende a calci il corpo senza vita ai suoi piedi. "Che sarei stata la tua pedina, il tuo strumento, il tuo oggetto per ottenere favori e promozioni?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The raven-haired woman laughs, as she cleans off her bloody dagger, and takes a step toward a figure cowering in the corner. The man you recognize as her father.|11195|0
units.english: The raven-haired woman laughs, as she cleans off her bloody dagger, and takes a step toward a figure cowering in the corner. The man you recognize as her father.
units.italian: La donna dai capelli corvini ride mentre pulisce il pugnale insanguinato, e fa un passo verso una figura rannicchiata nell'angolo. L'uomo che riconosci come suo padre.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Wh-what have you done? You've ruined everything. I was so close. I would have had it all." Deoric blinks, his face sets in hard, and he straightens up, he looks as if he just remembered who he is.|11196|0
units.english: "Wh-what have you done? You've ruined everything. I was so close. I would have had it all." Deoric blinks, his face sets in hard, and he straightens up, he looks as if he just remembered who he is.
units.italian: "C-che cosa hai fatto? Hai rovinato tutto. Ero così vicino. Avrei avuto tutto." Deoric sbatte le palpebre, il viso gli si indurisce, si raddrizza, sembra ricordarsi all'improvviso chi è.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"You stupid, selfish, arrogant brat. You just needed to do as you were told. To play your pathetic part. You couldn't, could you? You were always worthless. If only your brother had survived." Deoric picks up a broken furniture leg and confidently wields it like a club.|11197|0
units.english: "You stupid, selfish, arrogant brat. You just needed to do as you were told. To play your pathetic part. You couldn't, could you? You were always worthless. If only your brother had survived." Deoric picks up a broken furniture leg and confidently wields it like a club.
units.italian: "Stupida, egoista, arrogante ragazzina. Dovevi solo fare come ti si diceva. Recitare la tua patetica parte. Non ci sei riuscita, vero? Sei sempre stata senza valore. Se solo fosse sopravvissuto tuo fratello." Deoric afferra la gamba di un mobile rotto e la brandisce con sicurezza come una mazza.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	At this Ildico's wicked grin widens deeper. "My brother? Dear Hogne. Father, I killed him. He couldn't handle the ice, the isolation, the hopelessness of Hope. He lost his mind. He tried to make me his wife. And mother? She cracked long before that. An entitled debutante like her had no chance in that hellhole, and I? I needed to eat."|11198|0
units.english: At this Ildico's wicked grin widens deeper. "My brother? Dear Hogne. Father, I killed him. He couldn't handle the ice, the isolation, the hopelessness of Hope. He lost his mind. He tried to make me his wife. And mother? She cracked long before that. An entitled debutante like her had no chance in that hellhole, and I? I needed to eat."
units.italian: A queste parole il ghigno malvagio di Ildico si allarga ancora. "Mio fratello? Il caro Hogne. Padre, l'ho ucciso io. Non ha retto il ghiaccio, l'isolamento, la disperazione di Hope. Ha perso la testa. Ha cercato di farmi sua moglie. E mia madre? È crollata molto prima. Una debuttante viziata come lei non aveva scampo in quell'inferno, e io? Io dovevo mangiare."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The color drains out of Deoric's face. "Monster." He says. "I will put an end to you. I will start a new family, as I should have before."|11199|0
units.english: The color drains out of Deoric's face. "Monster." He says. "I will put an end to you. I will start a new family, as I should have before."
units.italian: Il colore svanisce dal viso di Deoric. "Mostro." Dice. "Ti farò finire. Comincerò una nuova famiglia, come avrei dovuto fare prima."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Deoric lunges at Ildico, but before he can take more then a single step, Ildico's wrist flicks and her knife slams into Deoric's throat. He falls to the ground, bleeding out, dying.|11200|0
units.english: Deoric lunges at Ildico, but before he can take more then a single step, Ildico's wrist flicks and her knife slams into Deoric's throat. He falls to the ground, bleeding out, dying.
units.italian: Deoric si lancia su Ildico, ma prima che possa fare più di un passo il polso di Ildico scatta e il suo coltello si conficca nella gola di Deoric. Cade a terra, dissanguandosi, morendo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico stands over him. "You are a coward. A miserable disgusting man." She spits on him, and pulls her dagger from his heaving neck. He tries to speak as his dying body squirms, but no words materialize and he goes still.|11201|0
units.english: Ildico stands over him. "You are a coward. A miserable disgusting man." She spits on him, and pulls her dagger from his heaving neck. He tries to speak as his dying body squirms, but no words materialize and he goes still.
units.italian: Ildico resta in piedi sopra di lui. "Sei un codardo. Un uomo miserabile e disgustoso." Gli sputa addosso e tira il pugnale dal collo che ancora si solleva. Lui cerca di parlare mentre il corpo morente si agita, ma nessuna parola prende forma e rimane immobile.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She turns to you. "I am now a fugitive, and you are my only friend. I need you to get us out of here."|11202|0
units.english: She turns to you. "I am now a fugitive, and you are my only friend. I need you to get us out of here."
units.italian: Si volta verso di te. "Ora sono una latitante, e tu sei il mio unico amico. Devo portarci via di qui."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico walks back to corner far from any of the fighting, and retrieves a bundled baby you'd neglected to notice until now.|11203|0
units.english: Ildico walks back to corner far from any of the fighting, and retrieves a bundled baby you'd neglected to notice until now.
units.italian: Ildico torna in un angolo lontano dalla colluttazione e recupera un neonato avvolto in una coperta, che finora non avevi notato.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"You got it. Let's go."|11205|0
units.english: "You got it. Let's go."
units.italian: "Ricevuto. Andiamo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Anything for you, Ildy."|11206|0
units.english: "Anything for you, Ildy."
units.italian: "Tutto per te, Ildy."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Sure, but you owe me. Big."|11207|0
units.english: "Sure, but you owe me. Big."
units.italian: "Certo, ma tu mi devi un favore. Grosso."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"No way. You're a murderer. I want nothing to do with you."|11208|0
units.english: "No way. You're a murderer. I want nothing to do with you."
units.italian: "Assolutamente no. Sei un'assassina. Non voglio avere niente a che fare con te."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Stop right there. I am putting you under citizen's arrest until the police arrive."|11210|0
units.english: "Stop right there. I am putting you under citizen's arrest until the police arrive."
units.italian: "Fermati subito. Ti metto in arresto cittadino fino all'arrivo della polizia."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She nods, her face softens, and tears glitter around her eyes. "Thank you, I knew- I knew I could count on you."|11213|0
units.english: She nods, her face softens, and tears glitter around her eyes. "Thank you, I knew- I knew I could count on you."
units.italian: Annuisce, il viso le si addolcisce, e lacrime le brillano intorno agli occhi. "Grazie, sapevo... sapevo di poter contare su di te."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico recollects herself for a moment before pointing to a briefcase lying by a table. "Grab that, and let's go."|11214|0
units.english: Ildico recollects herself for a moment before pointing to a briefcase lying by a table. "Grab that, and let's go."
units.italian: Ildico si ricompone per un momento, poi indica una valigetta appoggiata accanto a un tavolo. "Prendi quella e andiamo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Go where?"|11216|0
units.english: "Go where?"
units.italian: "Andiamo dove?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"What's in the briefcase?"|11218|0
units.english: "What's in the briefcase?"
units.italian: "Che c'è nella valigetta?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The recently widowed woman gives you a suspicious look, but then nods. "What I need to survive.|11219|0
units.english: The recently widowed woman gives you a suspicious look, but then nods. "What I need to survive.
units.italian: La donna appena rimasta vedova ti lancia uno sguardo sospettoso, poi annuisce. "Quello che mi serve per sopravvivere.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Now grab it, and let's go."|11220|0
units.english: "Now grab it, and let's go."
units.italian: "Ora prendila e andiamo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Go where?"|11222|0
units.english: "Go where?"
units.italian: "Andiamo dove?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	(Grab the briefcase.)|11224|0
units.english: (Grab the briefcase.)
units.italian: (Prendi la valigetta.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"We need to go where the Republic cannot. Take us to <planet>." She gives you a serious look and adds, "And do not let anyone scan your ship until we get there."|11225|0
units.english: "We need to go where the Republic cannot. Take us to <planet>." She gives you a serious look and adds, "And do not let anyone scan your ship until we get there."
units.italian: "Dobbiamo andare dove la Repubblica non può. Portaci su <planet>." Ti lancia uno sguardo serio e aggiunge: "E non lasciare che nessuno scansionino la nave finché non arriviamo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The three of you escape out into the night and onto your ship.|11226|0
units.english: The three of you escape out into the night and onto your ship.
units.italian: Uscite tutti e tre nella notte e salite sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She sighs. "Not the Republic, nor the Free Worlds. After tonight I will be hunted. We need to go to <planet>." She looks at you seriously and says, "And do not let anyone scan your ship until we get there."|11230|0
units.english: She sighs. "Not the Republic, nor the Free Worlds. After tonight I will be hunted. We need to go to <planet>." She looks at you seriously and says, "And do not let anyone scan your ship until we get there."
units.italian: Sospira. "Non la Repubblica, né i Free Worlds. Dopo stanotte sarò braccata. Dobbiamo andare su <planet>." Ti guarda seriamente e dice: "E non lasciare che nessuno scansionino la nave finché non arriviamo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	The three of you escape out into the night and onto your ship.|11231|0
units.english: The three of you escape out into the night and onto your ship.
units.italian: Uscite tutti e tre nella notte e salite sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico puts her baby back down, and for just a second you see agony in her eyes. Killing her father or her arranged husband didn't break her mask, but somehow this does. A tear rolls down her cheek. She moves fast, her arm darting and pointing a course at you, but the distance gives you just enough time to move. You barely avoid her dagger, and point your sidearm straight at her.|11235|0
units.english: Ildico puts her baby back down, and for just a second you see agony in her eyes. Killing her father or her arranged husband didn't break her mask, but somehow this does. A tear rolls down her cheek. She moves fast, her arm darting and pointing a course at you, but the distance gives you just enough time to move. You barely avoid her dagger, and point your sidearm straight at her.
units.italian: Ildico rimette giù il bambino, e per un solo secondo vedi l'agonia nei suoi occhi. Uccidere suo padre o il marito che le era stato imposto non ha incrinato la sua maschera, ma questo in qualche modo sì. Una lacrima le scende sulla guancia. Si muove veloce, il braccio scatta e punta nella tua direzione, ma la distanza ti dà appena il tempo di spostarti. Schivi a stento il pugnale e punti l'arma contro di lei.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	As you use your communicator to call the local authorities, Ildico glares at you, a broken expression on her face. "I thought I had one friend. What a fool I was. I'll never make that mistake again," is all she says, just as the security officers arrive. After a struggle, they manage to restrain Ildico, and separate her from the baby. Her stare pierces you all the way out of the estate. The officer in charge of the arrest thanks you for the report and for keeping Ildico in place until they arrived. They assure you that Ildico will be given a fair trial, and that the baby will be handled with care.|11236|0
units.english: As you use your communicator to call the local authorities, Ildico glares at you, a broken expression on her face. "I thought I had one friend. What a fool I was. I'll never make that mistake again," is all she says, just as the security officers arrive. After a struggle, they manage to restrain Ildico, and separate her from the baby. Her stare pierces you all the way out of the estate. The officer in charge of the arrest thanks you for the report and for keeping Ildico in place until they arrived. They assure you that Ildico will be given a fair trial, and that the baby will be handled with care.
units.italian: Mentre usi il comunicatore per chiamare le autorità locali, Ildico ti fissa con un'espressione spezzata. "Credevo di avere un amico. Che sciocca che sono stata. Non commetterò mai più questo errore," è tutto quello che dice, proprio mentre arrivano gli agenti di sicurezza. Dopo una colluttazione riescono a trattenere Ildico e a separarla dal bambino. Il suo sguardo ti trapassa fin fuori dalla tenuta. L'agente che dirige l'arresto ti ringrazia per la segnalazione e per aver tenuto ferma Ildico fino al loro arrivo. Ti assicurano che Ildico avrà un processo equo e che il bambino sarà trattato con cura.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	You watch the security vehicles take them both away, suddenly aware that you will likely never see either of them again.|11237|0
units.english: You watch the security vehicles take them both away, suddenly aware that you will likely never see either of them again.
units.italian: Guardi i veicoli di sicurezza portarli via entrambi, rendendoti conto all'improvviso che probabilmente non vedrai mai più nessuno dei due.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico puts her baby back down, and for just a second you see agony in her eyes. Killing her father or her arranged husband didn't break her mask, but somehow this does. A tear rolls down her cheek.|11241|0
units.english: Ildico puts her baby back down, and for just a second you see agony in her eyes. Killing her father or her arranged husband didn't break her mask, but somehow this does. A tear rolls down her cheek.
units.italian: Ildico rimette giù il bambino, e per un solo secondo vedi l'agonia nei suoi occhi. Uccidere suo padre o il marito che le era stato imposto non ha incrinato la sua maschera, ma questo in qualche modo sì. Una lacrima le scende sulla guancia.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Her hand wavers, trembles, over her knife, and then she drops it, and her head. "So then go."|11242|0
units.english: Her hand wavers, trembles, over her knife, and then she drops it, and her head. "So then go."
units.italian: La mano le trema sopra il coltello, poi lascia cadere sia quello sia il capo. "Allora vai."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|Having evaded Republic patrols on the lookout for the "Murderous Heiress," you make it to the pirate planet of Haven. Ildico watches the dismal landscape as you land and says, almost curtly, "It'll do."|11250|0
units.english: Having evaded Republic patrols on the lookout for the "Murderous Heiress," you make it to the pirate planet of Haven. Ildico watches the dismal landscape as you land and says, almost curtly, "It'll do."
units.italian: Dopo aver eluso le pattuglie della Repubblica a caccia dell'"Ereditiera Assassina", raggiungi il pianeta pirata di Haven. Ildico guarda il paesaggio desolato mentre atterri e dice, quasi seccamente: "Andrà bene."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She opens the briefcase she took off Chiron, revealing a storage device and an oranate wooden box.|11251|0
units.english: She opens the briefcase she took off Chiron, revealing a storage device and an oranate wooden box.
units.italian: Apre la valigetta che ha preso su Chiron, rivelando un dispositivo di archiviazione e una scatola di legno ornata.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico gives you a sly smile. "It took years, but the majority of the Drifa fortune has been smuggled into this storage device. They thought I was meek, malleable, and pitiful. Not a threat. They were fools."|11252|0
units.english: Ildico gives you a sly smile. "It took years, but the majority of the Drifa fortune has been smuggled into this storage device. They thought I was meek, malleable, and pitiful. Not a threat. They were fools."
units.italian: Ildico ti fa un sorriso malizioso. "Ci sono voluti anni, ma la maggior parte del patrimonio Drifa è stata fatta passare di nascosto in questo dispositivo. Credevano che fossi mite, malleabile e compassionevole. Non una minaccia. Erano sciocchi."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She holds up the box. "And in this, well, this may take some explaining. Before we migrated to Hope, the Drifa were old nobility in the Deep. Legend says we ruled Valhalla before the first ships came. Whatever the truth, my ancestors had this in their possession as a sign of their royalty, this bauble."|11253|0
units.english: She holds up the box. "And in this, well, this may take some explaining. Before we migrated to Hope, the Drifa were old nobility in the Deep. Legend says we ruled Valhalla before the first ships came. Whatever the truth, my ancestors had this in their possession as a sign of their royalty, this bauble."
units.italian: Solleva la scatola. "E qui dentro, beh, questo richiede qualche spiegazione. Prima di migrare su Hope, i Drifa erano antica nobiltà del Deep. La leggenda dice che governavamo Valhalla prima che arrivassero le prime navi. Qualunque sia la verità, i miei antenati avevano questo in loro possesso come segno della loro regalità, questo gingillo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	Ildico opens the rune-carved lid of the box, revealing a faintly glowing red rock. "It is called the Blood of Surtr, and it was said to have been the symbol of our rulership, and more importantly, a source of power."|11254|0
units.english: Ildico opens the rune-carved lid of the box, revealing a faintly glowing red rock. "It is called the Blood of Surtr, and it was said to have been the symbol of our rulership, and more importantly, a source of power."
units.italian: Ildico apre il coperchio della scatola intagliato con rune, rivelando una roccia rossa che emette un bagliore fiacco. "Si chiama il Sangue di Surtr, e si diceva che fosse il simbolo del nostro dominio e, cosa più importante, una fonte di potere."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She shrugs. "I know it sounds far-fetched. But I had this with me on Hope, and I don't think I would have survived without it. When the generators went down, this kept the lights on.|11255|0
units.english: She shrugs. "I know it sounds far-fetched. But I had this with me on Hope, and I don't think I would have survived without it. When the generators went down, this kept the lights on.
units.italian: Fa spallucce. "So che sembra inverosimile. Ma avevo questo con me su Hope, e non credo che sarei sopravvissuta senza. Quando i generatori sono caduti, questo ha tenuto le luci accese.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"But its time with me is over. I want you, the last friend of House Drifa, and the only person who has shown me any kindness in many years, to have it.|11256|0
units.english: "But its time with me is over. I want you, the last friend of House Drifa, and the only person who has shown me any kindness in many years, to have it.
units.italian: "Ma il suo tempo con me è finito. Voglio che l'abbia tu, l'ultimo amico della Casa Drifa e l'unica persona che mi abbia mostrato un po' di gentilezza in molti anni.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"I'll also transfer a small sum of money for your troubles. I fear I will be needing most of my family's fortune, but hopefully what little I can offer will help."|11258|0
units.english: "I'll also transfer a small sum of money for your troubles. I fear I will be needing most of my family's fortune, but hopefully what little I can offer will help."
units.italian: "Ti trasferirò anche una piccola somma per il disturbo. Temo che mi servirà quasi tutto il patrimonio di famiglia, ma spero che quel poco che posso offrirti aiuti."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Thank you."|11260|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"Is it wise for you and your child to be left alone in a place like Haven?"|11262|0
units.english: "Is it wise for you and your child to be left alone in a place like Haven?"
units.italian: "È saggio lasciare te e tuo figlio da soli in un posto come Haven?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She laughs. "After surviving on Hope and Chiron? Haven will be a cakewalk."|11264|0
units.english: She laughs. "After surviving on Hope and Chiron? Haven will be a cakewalk."
units.italian: Ride. "Dopo essere sopravvissuta su Hope e su Chiron? Haven sarà una passeggiata."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|label|11267|0
units.english: gotta go
units.italian: gotta go

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	"No, it is my appreciation that has to be given. You have done what few would have the conviction to do."|11268|0
units.english: "No, it is my appreciation that has to be given. You have done what few would have the conviction to do."
units.italian: "No, è la mia gratitudine che va data. Hai fatto quello che pochi avrebbero avuto la convinzione di fare."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 6|	She takes her child in one hand, and the briefcase in the other, and walks off your ship.|11271|0
units.english: She takes her child in one hand, and the briefcase in the other, and walks off your ship.
units.italian: Prende il bambino con una mano e la valigetta con l'altra, e scende dalla nave.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|name|11279|0
units.english: Meet Ildy on <planet>
units.italian: Incontrare Ildy su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|description|11280|0
units.english: See what Ildico needs on <destination>.
units.italian: Scopri di che cosa ha bisogno Ildico su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|Your inbox blinks with a new message from Ildico from Haven:|11288|0
units.english: Your inbox blinks with a new message from Ildico from Haven:
units.italian: La tua casella lampeggia con un nuovo messaggio da Ildico, da Haven:

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|	"It's been too long, and I could use your help. Please, come to <planet>.|11290|0
units.english: "It's been too long, and I could use your help. Please, come to <planet>.
units.italian: "È passato troppo tempo, e mi servirebbe il tuo aiuto. Ti prego, vieni su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|				- Your friend,|11291|0
units.english: - Your friend,
units.italian: - La tua amica,

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|					Ildy"|11292|0

units.italian: Ildy"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 7|Even from orbit, Haven looks ugly, and as you approach the planet it doesn't get any better. Upon landing you're alerted Ildico is waiting for you in the spaceport.|11296|0
units.english: Even from orbit, Haven looks ugly, and as you approach the planet it doesn't get any better. Upon landing you're alerted Ildico is waiting for you in the spaceport.
units.italian: Anche dall'orbita Haven è brutto, e avvicinandoti al pianeta non migliora. All'atterraggio sei avvisato che Ildico ti aspetta nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|name|11300|0
units.english: Defeat Ildico's rivals
units.italian: Sconfiggere i rivali di Ildico

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|description|11301|0
units.english: Ildico has requested you to destroy a fleet of Marauder ships near the <system> system. Once you're done, return to <planet>.
units.italian: Ildico ti ha chiesto di distruggere una flotta di navi Marauder vicino al sistema <system>. Quando hai finito, torna su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|You arrive at the address Ildico gave you; a large warehouse on the edge of the spaceport. When you step into the dimly lit building, your eyes struggle to adjust, and gradually you realize you're face-to-face with a group of dirty burly men and women leveling a half-dozen weapons right at you.|11307|0
units.english: You arrive at the address Ildico gave you; a large warehouse on the edge of the spaceport. When you step into the dimly lit building, your eyes struggle to adjust, and gradually you realize you're face-to-face with a group of dirty burly men and women leveling a half-dozen weapons right at you.
units.italian: Arrivi all'indirizzo che ti ha dato Ildico: un grande magazzino al margine dello spazioporto. Quando entri nell'edificio in penombra, i tuoi occhi faticano ad abituarsi, e a poco a poco ti accorgi di essere faccia a faccia con un gruppo di uomini e donne robusti e sporchi che ti puntano addosso una mezza dozzina di armi.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Looks like someone's lost," a voice rises from the group, though you can't tell who's speaking.|11308|0
units.english: "Looks like someone's lost," a voice rises from the group, though you can't tell who's speaking.
units.italian: "Pare che qualcuno si sia perso," si alza una voce dal gruppo, anche se non capisci chi stia parlando.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"They look right fancy. Good thing we found them."|11309|0
units.english: "They look right fancy. Good thing we found them."
units.italian: "Hanno un'aria distinta. Meno male che li abbiamo trovati."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Whaddya say, Frank, kill 'em now? Or keep 'em for a bit? Maybe their worth something? Maybe we can have some fun with 'em."|11310|0
units.english: "Whaddya say, Frank, kill 'em now? Or keep 'em for a bit? Maybe their worth something? Maybe we can have some fun with 'em."
units.italian: "Che ne dici, Frank, li ammazziamo subito? O li teniamo un po'? Magari valgono qualcosa? Magari ci divertiamo un po'."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"I am looking for Ildy."|11312|0
units.english: "I am looking for Ildy."
units.italian: "Sto cercando Ildy."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Ildy asked me to come here."|11313|0
units.english: "Ildy asked me to come here."
units.italian: "Ildy mi ha chiesto di venire qui."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Ildy, help!"|11314|0
units.english: "Ildy, help!"
units.italian: "Ildy, aiuto!"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Grab my sidearm and shoot my way out.)|11315|0
units.english: (Grab my sidearm and shoot my way out.)
units.italian: (Prendi l'arma e aprimi la strada sparando.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	The band of cut-throats looks at you, confused, and then most of them lower their weapons.|11318|0
units.english: The band of cut-throats looks at you, confused, and then most of them lower their weapons.
units.italian: La banda di tagliagole ti guarda, confusa, poi la maggior parte abbassa le armi.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Boss," one of them hollers, "this stranger says they're here for you, I think."|11319|0
units.english: "Boss," one of them hollers, "this stranger says they're here for you, I think."
units.italian: "Capo," grida uno di loro, "questo tizio dice che è qui per te, credo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Footsteps echo on the opposite side of the warehouse as someone approaches.|11320|0
units.english: Footsteps echo on the opposite side of the warehouse as someone approaches.
units.italian: Passi riecheggiano dal lato opposto del magazzino mentre qualcuno si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	One of the men starts laughing. "Ildy?! Haha, never thought to call her that. Hey Ildy! How come you never told us to call you that? Or that some kind of special pet name?"|11321|0
units.english: One of the men starts laughing. "Ildy?! Haha, never thought to call her that. Hey Ildy! How come you never told us to call you that? Or that some kind of special pet name?"
units.italian: Uno degli uomini scoppia a ridere. "Ildy?! Ahah, non avrei mai pensato di chiamarla così. Ehi Ildy! Come mai non ci hai mai detto di chiamarti così? O è una specie di nomignolo speciale?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	The man flashes an unsavory grin at you, with his rotting teeth on full display.|11322|0
units.english: The man flashes an unsavory grin at you, with his rotting teeth on full display.
units.italian: L'uomo ti rivolge un ghigno sgradevole, con i denti marci in bella mostra.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	In the dim light the footsteps materialize into a woman in her mid-thirties with hair darker than vacuum. Ildico Drifa gives you a warm smile, then lifts up a gun and fires.|11323|0
units.english: In the dim light the footsteps materialize into a woman in her mid-thirties with hair darker than vacuum. Ildico Drifa gives you a warm smile, then lifts up a gun and fires.
units.italian: Nella penombra i passi prendono forma di una donna sulla trentina con i capelli più scuri del vuoto. Ildico Drifa ti rivolge un sorriso caldo, poi alza una pistola e spara.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Duck.)|11325|0
units.english: (Duck.)
units.italian: (Abbassati.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Jump to the side.)|11327|0
units.english: (Jump to the side.)
units.italian: (Salta di lato.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Do nothing.)|11329|0
units.english: (Do nothing.)
units.italian: (Non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	You don't flinch as the rotten-toothed man besides you crumples to the ground, a bullet hole in his head.|11330|0
units.english: You don't flinch as the rotten-toothed man besides you crumples to the ground, a bullet hole in his head.
units.italian: Non sussulti mentre l'uomo dai denti marci accanto a te crolla a terra, con un foro di proiettile nella testa.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	You jump to the side, knocking against some empty barrels, only to realize she wasn't aiming at you. The rotten-toothed man lies dead on the ground, a bullet hole in his head.|11333|0
units.english: You jump to the side, knocking against some empty barrels, only to realize she wasn't aiming at you. The rotten-toothed man lies dead on the ground, a bullet hole in his head.
units.italian: Salti di lato, urtando dei barili vuoti, solo per capire che non stava mirando a te. L'uomo dai denti marci giace morto a terra, con un foro di proiettile nella testa.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	You duck, startled by the attack, only to realize she wasn't aiming at you. The rotten-toothed man lies dead on the ground, a bullet hole in his head.|11336|0
units.english: You duck, startled by the attack, only to realize she wasn't aiming at you. The rotten-toothed man lies dead on the ground, a bullet hole in his head.
units.italian: Ti abbassi, sorpreso dall'attacco, solo per capire che non stava mirando a te. L'uomo dai denti marci giace morto a terra, con un foro di proiettile nella testa.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|label|11337|0
units.english: only friends
units.italian: only friends

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	She looks to the rest of her crew, "Only my friends call me Ildy. And I have only one friend."|11338|0
units.english: She looks to the rest of her crew, "Only my friends call me Ildy. And I have only one friend."
units.italian: Guarda il resto del suo equipaggio: "Solo i miei amici mi chiamano Ildy. E ho un solo amico."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Yes, boss."|11339|0
units.english: "Yes, boss."
units.italian: "Sì, capo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Got it, boss."|11340|0
units.english: "Got it, boss."
units.italian: "Ricevuto, capo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Sure thing, Cap."|11341|0
units.english: "Sure thing, Cap."
units.italian: "Come vuoi, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Whatever you say, boss."|11342|0
units.english: "Whatever you say, boss."
units.italian: "Come dici tu, capo."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	The group of pirates melt away into the warehouse, one of them dragging the dead body, leaving you and Ildy relatively alone.|11343|0
units.english: The group of pirates melt away into the warehouse, one of them dragging the dead body, leaving you and Ildy relatively alone.
units.italian: Il gruppo di pirati si dissolve nel magazzino, uno di loro trascinando il cadavere, lasciando te e Ildy relativamente soli.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"I'm glad you came, <first>." Ildico puts a friendly hand on your shoulder and squeezes.|11344|0
units.english: "I'm glad you came, <first>." Ildico puts a friendly hand on your shoulder and squeezes.
units.italian: "Sono contenta che tu sia venuto, <first>." Ildico ti mette una mano amichevole sulla spalla e la stringe.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	She turns and waves toward the warehouse. "This is my temporary headquarters. I have few other safe-houses, and I own part of a hangar elsewhere. Not too many ships yet, but that will change soon."|11345|0
units.english: She turns and waves toward the warehouse. "This is my temporary headquarters. I have few other safe-houses, and I own part of a hangar elsewhere. Not too many ships yet, but that will change soon."
units.italian: Si volta e indica il magazzino. "Questo è il mio quartier generale temporaneo. Ho pochi altri rifugi e possiedo parte di un hangar altrove. Non ho ancora molte navi, ma cambierà presto."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Ildico holsters her gun right next to where she keeps her ornate dagger and continues. "But making moves is hard. Everyone wants to be on top. Which is why I need you."|11346|0
units.english: Ildico holsters her gun right next to where she keeps her ornate dagger and continues. "But making moves is hard. Everyone wants to be on top. Which is why I need you."
units.italian: Ildico rimette la pistola nella fondina proprio accanto al pugnale ornato e continua. "Ma muoversi è difficile. Tutti vogliono stare in cima. Ed è per questo che ho bisogno di te."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	She looks you in the eye and says, "There's a rival gang right next door. They have a lot more firepower, but if they could be removed, we could easily double our territory.|11347|0
units.english: She looks you in the eye and says, "There's a rival gang right next door. They have a lot more firepower, but if they could be removed, we could easily double our territory.
units.italian: Ti guarda negli occhi e dice: "C'è una banda rivale proprio qui accanto. Hanno molta più potenza di fuoco, ma se venissero eliminati potremmo facilmente raddoppiare il nostro territorio.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"I don't have the ships," she glances at her gang in the distance, "or the quality of crew, to deal with them.|11348|0
units.english: "I don't have the ships," she glances at her gang in the distance, "or the quality of crew, to deal with them.
units.italian: "Non ho le navi," dà un'occhiata alla sua banda in lontananza, "né la qualità dell'equipaggio, per occuparmene.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"But I think you do. I can't afford to pay you right now, things are pretty fluid, but I'll owe you. So, are you in?"|11349|0
units.english: "But I think you do. I can't afford to pay you right now, things are pretty fluid, but I'll owe you. So, are you in?"
units.italian: "Ma credo che ce l'abbia tu. Non posso permettermi di pagarti adesso, le cose sono piuttosto fluide, ma ti sarò in debito. Allora, ci stai?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Sure, I'll help."|11351|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll help."
units.italian: "Certo, ti aiuto."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Fine. But you're going to owe me big when this is all over."|11352|0
units.english: "Fine. But you're going to owe me big when this is all over."
units.italian: "Va bene. Ma quando sarà finita mi dovrai un favore grosso."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Anything for you, Ildy."|11353|0
units.english: "Anything for you, Ildy."
units.italian: "Tutto per te, Ildy."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Not interested."|11354|0
units.english: "Not interested."
units.italian: "Non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Her smile lights up the dim room. "I always know I can count on you. And only you."|11357|0
units.english: Her smile lights up the dim room. "I always know I can count on you. And only you."
units.italian: Il suo sorriso illumina la stanza in penombra. "Sapevo di poter contare su di te. E solo su di te."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"I fed the gang some false information. They have their entire fleet hunting some juicy merchant ships that don't actually exist, so they'll be surprised when they find you instead."|11358|0
units.english: "I fed the gang some false information. They have their entire fleet hunting some juicy merchant ships that don't actually exist, so they'll be surprised when they find you instead."
units.italian: "Ho dato alla banda informazioni false. Hanno tutta la flotta a caccia di alcune succose navi mercantili che non esistono, così saranno sorpresi quando troveranno te."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Check out the nearby systems and look for their flagship, the <npc>. Kill them all, and come back here. To me."|11359|0
units.english: "Check out the nearby systems and look for their flagship, the <npc>. Kill them all, and come back here. To me."
units.italian: "Controlla i sistemi vicini e cerca la loro ammiraglia, la <npc>. Uccidili tutti e torna qui. Da me."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Ildico frowns. She looks down at her feet for a moment, and when she looks back up her face is a mask of rage and hurt. "Then get out."|11363|0
units.english: Ildico frowns. She looks down at her feet for a moment, and when she looks back up her face is a mask of rage and hurt. "Then get out."
units.italian: Ildico si acciglia. Guarda i suoi piedi per un momento e quando rialza lo sguardo il suo viso è una maschera di rabbia e dolore. "Allora vattene."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Acting defiantly in the face of so much danger, you reach for your sidearm. Unfortunately, it's in vain, because as soon as you feel the pistol grip in your hand you simultaneously feel the burning sensations of a flurry of bullets entering your body and tearing apart your insides.|11367|0
units.english: Acting defiantly in the face of so much danger, you reach for your sidearm. Unfortunately, it's in vain, because as soon as you feel the pistol grip in your hand you simultaneously feel the burning sensations of a flurry of bullets entering your body and tearing apart your insides.
units.italian: Sfidandola davanti a tanto pericolo, allunghi la mano verso l'arma. Purtroppo è inutile, perché appena senti l'impugnatura nella mano senti nello stesso istante le sensazioni brucianti di una raffica di proiettili che ti entra nel corpo e ti squarcia le viscere.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|dialog|11376|0
units.english: The rival pirate fleet has been destroyed. You should return to Haven now to check up on Ildico.
units.italian: La flotta pirata rivale è stata distrutta. Dovresti tornare su Haven per controllare come sta Ildico.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|There's been intense fighting around the district where Ildico's warehouse was located. A few gunshots echo as you make your way through the rubble and around the fires.|11383|0
units.english: There's been intense fighting around the district where Ildico's warehouse was located. A few gunshots echo as you make your way through the rubble and around the fires.
units.italian: Ci sono stati combattimenti intensi nel distretto dove si trovava il magazzino di Ildico. Qualche colpo di pistola riecheggia mentre ti fai strada fra le macerie e intorno agli incendi.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	A group of injured but high-spirited pirates are set up outside the building, and there are bodies littering the nearby streets. An unharmed but bloody Ildico walks up to you, smiling. She is trailed by a small incongruous toddler with short black hair and lopsided grin.|11384|0
units.english: A group of injured but high-spirited pirates are set up outside the building, and there are bodies littering the nearby streets. An unharmed but bloody Ildico walks up to you, smiling. She is trailed by a small incongruous toddler with short black hair and lopsided grin.
units.italian: Un gruppo di pirati feriti ma pieni di spirito si è sistemato fuori dall'edificio, e i corpi ingombrano le strade vicine. Una Ildico illesa ma insanguinata ti viene incontro sorridendo. La segue un piccolo bambino incongruo, con i capelli neri corti e un sorriso storto.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Perfect. They never had a chance." She wipes the blood off her dagger, and notices your gaze.|11385|0
units.english: "Perfect. They never had a chance." She wipes the blood off her dagger, and notices your gaze.
units.italian: "Perfetto. Non hanno avuto scampo." Pulisce il sangue dal pugnale e nota il tuo sguardo.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"The safest place for her was by my side," she says matter-of-factly to you, then she kneels down to her daughter. "Randalin, this is <first>. You met them long ago when you were a baby. <first> is my friend."|11386|0
units.english: "The safest place for her was by my side," she says matter-of-factly to you, then she kneels down to her daughter. "Randalin, this is <first>. You met them long ago when you were a baby. <first> is my friend."
units.italian: "Il posto più sicuro per lei era al mio fianco," ti dice con naturalezza, poi si inginocchia davanti a sua figlia. "Randalin, questo è <first>. L'hai conosciuto molto tempo fa, quando eri una neonata. <first> è mio amico."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	She stands up again and looks back at you. "And <first>, this is Randalin. She's grown a bit since last you saw her."|11387|0
units.english: She stands up again and looks back at you. "And <first>, this is Randalin. She's grown a bit since last you saw her."
units.italian: Si rialza e torna a guardarti. "E <first>, questa è Randalin. È cresciuta un po' dall'ultima volta che l'hai vista."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"Hi, Randalin. It's wonderful to meet you."|11389|0
units.english: "Hi, Randalin. It's wonderful to meet you."
units.italian: "Ciao, Randalin. È bellissimo conoscerti."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Nod at the child.)|11391|0
units.english: (Nod at the child.)
units.italian: (Accenna un cenno alla bambina.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"She was with you for the battle?"|11393|0
units.english: "She was with you for the battle?"
units.italian: "Era con te durante la battaglia?"

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Ildico shrugs. "Who would I trust with her? Who could I trust with her? Only you, <first>, and you were elsewhere."|11394|0
units.english: Ildico shrugs. "Who would I trust with her? Who could I trust with her? Only you, <first>, and you were elsewhere."
units.italian: Ildico fa spallucce. "A chi l'avrei affidata? A chi avrei potuto affidarla? Solo a te, <first>, e tu eri altrove."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|label|11397|0
units.english: hi rand
units.italian: hi rand

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	The little girl lifts a chubby fist up to you.|11398|0
units.english: The little girl lifts a chubby fist up to you.
units.italian: La bambina alza un pugnetto paffuto verso di te.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Fist bump her.)|11400|0
units.english: (Fist bump her.)
units.italian: (Batti il pugno con il suo.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	(Shake her fist.)|11402|0
units.english: (Shake her fist.)
units.italian: (Stringile il pugno.)

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	You awkwardly take her fist in your hand and shake it up and down. Randalin giggles, and babbles something incoherent.|11403|0
units.english: You awkwardly take her fist in your hand and shake it up and down. Randalin giggles, and babbles something incoherent.
units.italian: Prendi goffamente il suo pugno nella mano e lo scuoti su e giù. Randalin ridacchia e farfuglia qualcosa di incomprensibile.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Her small fist bumps against yours. She then gives you an easy grin and babbles something incoherent.|11407|0
units.english: Her small fist bumps against yours. She then gives you an easy grin and babbles something incoherent.
units.italian: Il suo piccolo pugno batte contro il tuo. Poi ti regala un sorriso spontaneo e farfuglia qualcosa di incomprensibile.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"She's not quite got the hang of words yet. But they'll come," Ildico says approvingly.|11410|0
units.english: "She's not quite got the hang of words yet. But they'll come," Ildico says approvingly.
units.italian: "Non ha ancora preso la mano con le parole. Ma arriveranno," dice Ildico con approvazione.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|label|11412|0
units.english: only you
units.italian: only you

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Ilidco puts a hand on Randalin's shoulder and draws her close. She turns her attention back to the battlefield.|11413|0
units.english: Ilidco puts a hand on Randalin's shoulder and draws her close. She turns her attention back to the battlefield.
units.italian: Ildico mette una mano sulla spalla di Randalin e la tira a sé. Poi riporta l'attenzione sul campo di battaglia.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	"This is only the beginning, <first>." Her eyes blaze as she speaks, "House Drifa will rise again. You'll see. You'll be there."|11414|0
units.english: "This is only the beginning, <first>." Her eyes blaze as she speaks, "House Drifa will rise again. You'll see. You'll be there."
units.italian: "Questo è solo l'inizio, <first>." Gli occhi le ardono mentre parla, "La Casa Drifa risorgerà. Vedrai. Tu ci sarai."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	She glances back toward her mulling forces. "Thanks again, it means a lot that I can count on you, but I have to work to do. Until next time."|11415|0
units.english: She glances back toward her mulling forces. "Thanks again, it means a lot that I can count on you, but I have to work to do. Until next time."
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata alle sue forze in attesa. "Grazie ancora, significa molto poter contare su di te, ma ho del lavoro da fare. Alla prossima."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen 8|	Ildico returns to her group, barking orders and gesturing at the rubble, leaving you to your own devices.|11416|0
units.english: Ildico returns to her group, barking orders and gesturing at the rubble, leaving you to your own devices.
units.italian: Ildico torna al suo gruppo, impartendo ordini e indicando le macerie, lasciandoti fare quello che vuoi.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen: News|A news kiosk is doing a segment on the growing threat of pirates around Haven. A certain name catches your eye, and you read:|11428|0
units.english: A news kiosk is doing a segment on the growing threat of pirates around Haven. A certain name catches your eye, and you read:
units.italian: Un chiosco di notizie sta trasmettendo un servizio sulla crescente minaccia dei pirati intorno a Haven. Un nome ti colpisce, e leggi:

units.id: mission:Ice Queen: News|	Self-styled "pirate queen" Ildico Drifa continues to expand her territory and reach. While there is some concern this growing centralization of power could result in greater threats to trade and stability in the Far North, most analysts think it is quite unlikely.|11429|0
units.english: Self-styled "pirate queen" Ildico Drifa continues to expand her territory and reach. While there is some concern this growing centralization of power could result in greater threats to trade and stability in the Far North, most analysts think it is quite unlikely.
units.italian: La "regina dei pirati" autoproclamata Ildico Drifa continua ad ampliare il suo territorio e la sua influenza. Sebbene ci sia una certa preoccupazione che questa crescente centralizzazione del potere possa portare a maggiori minacce per il commercio e la stabilità nel Far North, la maggior parte degli analisti ritiene che sia piuttosto improbabile.

units.id: mission:Ice Queen: News|	Professor Grenwich Millstone, foremost authority on the economy and history of the northern pirate worlds, had this to say about Drifa:|11430|0
units.english: Professor Grenwich Millstone, foremost authority on the economy and history of the northern pirate worlds, had this to say about Drifa:
units.italian: Il professor Grenwich Millstone, massima autorità sull'economia e la storia dei mondi pirata settentrionali, ha detto questo su Drifa:

units.id: mission:Ice Queen: News|	"It is patently inconceivable that any single magnate could consolidate power on Haven. It is cultural anathema, and economically impractical. Frankly, all this talk of a so-called 'pirate queen' is just sensationalist journalism trying to sell the news. In a few weeks another pirate captain will be the new bogeyman, and then another."|11431|0
units.english: "It is patently inconceivable that any single magnate could consolidate power on Haven. It is cultural anathema, and economically impractical. Frankly, all this talk of a so-called 'pirate queen' is just sensationalist journalism trying to sell the news. In a few weeks another pirate captain will be the new bogeyman, and then another."
units.italian: "È palesemente inconcepibile che un singolo magnate possa consolidare il potere su Haven. È un'anatema culturale, oltre che economicamente impraticabile. Francamente, tutto questo parlare di una cosiddetta 'regina dei pirati' è solo giornalismo sensazionalista che cerca di vendere notizie. Fra qualche settimana un altro capitano pirata sarà il nuovo spauracchio, e poi un altro."

units.id: mission:Ice Queen: News|	The segment ends, and the news kiosk automatically scrolls down to the next article.|11432|0
units.english: The segment ends, and the news kiosk automatically scrolls down to the next article.
units.italian: Il servizio termina, e il chiosco scorre automaticamente al prossimo articolo.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|As your ship descends through Windblain's cloudy atmosphere, you consider landing near Hrithfjall and asking the Ondurdis about the Blood of Surtr.|11445|0
units.english: As your ship descends through Windblain's cloudy atmosphere, you consider landing near Hrithfjall and asking the Ondurdis about the Blood of Surtr.
units.italian: Mentre la nave scende attraverso l'atmosfera nuvolosa di Windblain, consideri l'idea di atterrare vicino a Hrithfjall e chiedere all'Ondurdis del Sangue di Surtr.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	(Take the Blood of Surtr to Hrithfjall.)|11447|0
units.english: (Take the Blood of Surtr to Hrithfjall.)
units.italian: (Porta il Sangue di Surtr a Hrithfjall.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	(Ask about the Blood of Surtr another time.)|11449|0
units.english: (Ask about the Blood of Surtr another time.)
units.italian: (Chiedi del Sangue di Surtr un'altra volta.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	(Don't visit Hrithfjall at all.)|11451|0
units.english: (Don't visit Hrithfjall at all.)
units.italian: (Non visitare affatto Hrithfjall.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	You fly past Hrithfjall without landing and continue on your way.|11454|0
units.english: You fly past Hrithfjall without landing and continue on your way.
units.italian: Sorvoli Hrithfjall senza atterrare e prosegui per la tua strada.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	You pass numerous new homes built of driftwood and sea-stone as you approach the old village center of Hrithfjall. There is laughter and song in the air and children running everywhere; it always seems larger every time you visit.|11458|0
units.english: You pass numerous new homes built of driftwood and sea-stone as you approach the old village center of Hrithfjall. There is laughter and song in the air and children running everywhere; it always seems larger every time you visit.
units.italian: Passi accanto a numerose case nuove costruite con legni portati dal mare e pietra marina mentre ti avvicini al vecchio centro del villaggio di Hrithfjall. Nell'aria ci sono risate e canti e bambini che corrono ovunque; sembra sempre più grande ogni volta che lo visiti.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	At the old village hall you find the Ondurdis and Aldfrith deep in conversation with a band of people who stick out beside the Skadenga and indigenous Ranfolk; these people appear to be foreigners. The Ondurdis's old eyes light up and she gives you a grandmotherly smile as you approach.|11459|0
units.english: At the old village hall you find the Ondurdis and Aldfrith deep in conversation with a band of people who stick out beside the Skadenga and indigenous Ranfolk; these people appear to be foreigners. The Ondurdis's old eyes light up and she gives you a grandmotherly smile as you approach.
units.italian: Nella vecchia sala del villaggio trovi l'Ondurdis e Aldfrith in profonda conversazione con un gruppo di persone che spiccano accanto agli Skadenga e ai Ranfolk indigeni; queste persone sembrano forestieri. Gli occhi vecchi dell'Ondurdis si illuminano e ti rivolge un sorriso da nonna mentre ti avvicini.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"<first>!" the Ondurdis exclaims happily. "My heart sings to see you."|11460|0
units.english: "<first>!" the Ondurdis exclaims happily. "My heart sings to see you."
units.italian: "<first>!" esclama felice l'Ondurdis. "Mi canta il cuore a vederti."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"Who are they?"|11462|0
units.english: "Who are they?"
units.italian: "Chi sono?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"I've come to show you something."|11464|0
units.english: "I've come to show you something."
units.italian: "Sono venuto a mostrarti una cosa."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"What do you know about other stones like the Tear of Skade?"|11466|0
units.english: "What do you know about other stones like the Tear of Skade?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sai di altre pietre come la Lacrima di Skade?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"On Skade? Only Tears of Skade. But on other worlds? Maybe."|11469|0
units.english: "On Skade? Only Tears of Skade. But on other worlds? Maybe."
units.italian: "Su Skade? Solo Lacrime di Skade. Ma su altri mondi? Forse."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	The Ondurdis steps away from the group and takes you aside, leaving Aldfrith to continue talking with them.|11473|0
units.english: The Ondurdis steps away from the group and takes you aside, leaving Aldfrith to continue talking with them.
units.italian: L'Ondurdis si allontana dal gruppo e ti prende in disparte, lasciando Aldfrith a continuare a parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"They are from Alfheim. They say their culture and world dying and they look for new home before old one gone." She pats your arm gently.|11474|0
units.english: "They are from Alfheim. They say their culture and world dying and they look for new home before old one gone." She pats your arm gently.
units.italian: "Vengono da Alfheim. Dicono loro cultura e mondo stanno morendo e cercano nuova casa prima che vecchia sparisca." Ti accarezza il braccio con delicatezza.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"Word spreads of Hrithfjell and in some corners of Deep old ways still remembered. So they come." Her eyes gleam, "We are like fire on glacier. All see, all come. For warmth, for happiness, for life.|11475|0
units.english: "Word spreads of Hrithfjell and in some corners of Deep old ways still remembered. So they come." Her eyes gleam, "We are like fire on glacier. All see, all come. For warmth, for happiness, for life.
units.italian: "La voce di Hrithfjell si sparge e in alcuni angoli del Deep le vecchie usanze ancora si ricordano. Così vengono." Gli occhi le brillano, "Noi siamo come fuoco su ghiacciaio. Tutti vedono, tutti vengono. Per calore, per felicità, per vita.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"But, <first>, you have not come all this way to talk with old woman. What brings you here?"|11476|0
units.english: "But, <first>, you have not come all this way to talk with old woman. What brings you here?"
units.italian: "Ma, <first>, non hai fatto tutta questa strada per parlare con vecchia donna. Che cosa ti porta qui?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	You show her the Blood of Surtr, and tell her the story of House Drifa taking it from the Deep.|11481|0
units.english: You show her the Blood of Surtr, and tell her the story of House Drifa taking it from the Deep.
units.italian: Le mostri il Sangue di Surtr e le racconti la storia della Casa Drifa che lo prese dal Deep.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	The Ondurdis nods slowly. "I only know of Tears of Skade. Our Goddess cried - maybe others did as well?"|11482|0
units.english: The Ondurdis nods slowly. "I only know of Tears of Skade. Our Goddess cried - maybe others did as well?"
units.italian: L'Ondurdis annuisce lentamente. "Io conosco solo Lacrime di Skade. Nostra Dea ha pianto, forse anche altri hanno pianto?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	She turns and motions to Aldfrith who steps over to you. She asks, "Did Ran ever cry cold tears?"|11483|0
units.english: She turns and motions to Aldfrith who steps over to you. She asks, "Did Ran ever cry cold tears?"
units.italian: Si volta e fa cenno ad Aldfrith, che si avvicina. Gli chiede: "Ran ha mai pianto lacrime fredde?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	Aldfrith inspects the Blood of Surtr thoughtfully, and then considers the Ondurdis's words as he strokes his white beard. "The sea has no mercy, and no memory. Ran would never cry."|11486|0
units.english: Aldfrith inspects the Blood of Surtr thoughtfully, and then considers the Ondurdis's words as he strokes his white beard. "The sea has no mercy, and no memory. Ran would never cry."
units.italian: Aldfrith esamina il Sangue di Surtr pensieroso, poi riflette sulle parole dell'Ondurdis accarezzandosi la barba bianca. "Il mare non ha pietà, né memoria. Ran non piangerebbe mai."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	He chews his lip and then says slowly and carefully, "But she did leave us scales."|11487|0
units.english: He chews his lip and then says slowly and carefully, "But she did leave us scales."
units.italian: Si mordicchia il labbro e poi dice lento e attento: "Ma ci ha lasciato le squame."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	He nods to himself and becomes more confident. "Long ago we would find the Scales of Ran on the beaches nearest her God-Stone. The stories say that they made a bubble of breathable air around those who carried them, and allowed us to explore the secrets of her depths."|11488|0
units.english: He nods to himself and becomes more confident. "Long ago we would find the Scales of Ran on the beaches nearest her God-Stone. The stories say that they made a bubble of breathable air around those who carried them, and allowed us to explore the secrets of her depths."
units.italian: Annuisce fra sé e si fa più sicuro. "Molto tempo fa trovavamo le Squame di Ran sulle spiagge più vicine alla sua Pietra-Divina. Le storie dicono che creavano una bolla d'aria respirabile intorno a chi le portava, e ci permettevano di esplorare i segreti delle sue profondità."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"What happened to them?"|11490|0
units.english: "What happened to them?"
units.italian: "Che fine hanno fatto?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"Where could I find them?"|11491|0
units.english: "Where could I find them?"
units.italian: "Dove potrei trovarle?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	Aldfrith shakes his head slowly. "In the time of my grandfather the men from the Deep came and took the Scales off world. They said they were too valuable to be left in the hands of savages, and since then we've never found another Scale of Ran. I think she was displeased we allowed them to be taken."|11493|0
units.english: Aldfrith shakes his head slowly. "In the time of my grandfather the men from the Deep came and took the Scales off world. They said they were too valuable to be left in the hands of savages, and since then we've never found another Scale of Ran. I think she was displeased we allowed them to be taken."
units.italian: Aldfrith scuote lentamente la testa. "Ai tempi di mio nonno gli uomini del Deep vennero e portarono le Squame fuori dal mondo. Dicevano che erano troppo preziose per essere lasciate in mano ai selvaggi, e da allora non abbiamo più trovato un'altra Squama di Ran. Credo che lei non fosse contenta che le avessimo lasciate prendere."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	The old man pauses for a moment and then says, "Although... I do remember when I was a child the folk from the Deep coming and visiting us again. They had questions about... our baubles. I think they said they did not work? They thought they were just useless charms. Perhaps the Scales stopped working?"|11494|0
units.english: The old man pauses for a moment and then says, "Although... I do remember when I was a child the folk from the Deep coming and visiting us again. They had questions about... our baubles. I think they said they did not work? They thought they were just useless charms. Perhaps the Scales stopped working?"
units.italian: Il vecchio tace per un momento e poi dice: "Però... ricordo che da bambino la gente del Deep venne a visitarci di nuovo. Avevano domande sui nostri... gingilli. Credo dicessero che non funzionavano? Pensavano fossero solo ciondoli inutili. Forse le Squame hanno smesso di funzionare?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	He shrugs. "I am sorry, <first>, that I cannot tell you more."|11495|0
units.english: He shrugs. "I am sorry, <first>, that I cannot tell you more."
units.italian: Fa spallucce. "Mi dispiace, <first>, di non poterti dire di più."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	The Ondurdis puts a hand on his back. "I value your stories." She turns her attention back to you, "Stone-magic fades when outsiders come, this is known. Maybe all God-Stones once gave such gifts, but no longer."|11496|0
units.english: The Ondurdis puts a hand on his back. "I value your stories." She turns her attention back to you, "Stone-magic fades when outsiders come, this is known. Maybe all God-Stones once gave such gifts, but no longer."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis gli mette una mano sulla schiena. "Io apprezzo le tue storie." Poi riporta l'attenzione su di te: "La magia delle pietre svanisce quando arrivano gli estranei, questo si sa. Forse tutte le Pietre-Divine un tempo davano questi doni, ma non più."

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	She points at the Blood of Surtr. "Surtr, is known, he is volcano that erupts on ice. He is black fire that swallows world. But he had no God-Stone on Nifel." She pauses and looks at Aldfrith.|11497|0
units.english: She points at the Blood of Surtr. "Surtr, is known, he is volcano that erupts on ice. He is black fire that swallows world. But he had no God-Stone on Nifel." She pauses and looks at Aldfrith.
units.italian: Indica il Sangue di Surtr. "Surtr, si sa, è vulcano che erutta sul ghiaccio. È fuoco nero che inghiotte mondo. Ma lui non aveva Pietra-Divina su Nifel." Si ferma e guarda Aldfrith.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"Oh, uh, and none here. Ran, like the sea, is jealous and would share no world with another." Aldfrith says quickly.|11498|0
units.english: "Oh, uh, and none here. Ran, like the sea, is jealous and would share no world with another." Aldfrith says quickly.
units.italian: "Oh, ehm, e neppure qui. Ran, come il mare, è gelosa e non avrebbe diviso un mondo con un altro." dice Aldfrith in fretta.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	"Maybe on other world, there is Surtr God-Stone, and from it he bleeds. More than that, I do not know," she says apologetically.|11499|0
units.english: "Maybe on other world, there is Surtr God-Stone, and from it he bleeds. More than that, I do not know," she says apologetically.
units.italian: "Forse su altro mondo c'è Pietra-Divina di Surtr, e da quella lui sanguina. Di più non so," dice con dispiacere.

units.id: mission:Skadenga: Blood of Surtr|	You thank the Ondurdis and Aldfrith for their gracious help and interesting stories. The Ondurdis hastily prepares a small meal, believing it bad manners to let a guest leave unfed, and wishes you well in your future travels among the lofty stars.|11500|0
units.english: You thank the Ondurdis and Aldfrith for their gracious help and interesting stories. The Ondurdis hastily prepares a small meal, believing it bad manners to let a guest leave unfed, and wishes you well in your future travels among the lofty stars.
units.italian: Ringrazi l'Ondurdis e Aldfrith per l'aiuto cortese e le storie interessanti. L'Ondurdis prepara in fretta un piccolo pasto, convinta che sia da maleducati lasciare andare via un ospite senza cibo, e ti augura ogni bene nei tuoi futuri viaggi fra le stelle alte.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|In the quiet, creaking spaceport, it's easy enough to spot Helm doing some much needed maintenance on the ships that have landed here for the night. The last time you met him, he asked you to bring a stone to Hope. Do you want to check in with him?|11510|0
units.english: In the quiet, creaking spaceport, it's easy enough to spot Helm doing some much needed maintenance on the ships that have landed here for the night. The last time you met him, he asked you to bring a stone to Hope. Do you want to check in with him?
units.italian: Nello spazioporto silenzioso e scricchiolante è facile notare Helm che fa manutenzione necessaria alle navi arrivate qui per la notte. L'ultima volta che l'hai incontrato ti ha chiesto di portare una pietra su Hope. Vuoi andare a parlargli?

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	(Go to Helm and report on the stone.)|11512|0
units.english: (Go to Helm and report on the stone.)
units.italian: (Vai da Helm e riferisci della pietra.)

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	(Leave Helm alone.)|11514|0
units.english: (Leave Helm alone.)
units.italian: (Lascia in pace Helm.)

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	As you say your hello you accidentally startle Helm, who's in the middle of recalibrating a repulsor.|11518|0
units.english: As you say your hello you accidentally startle Helm, who's in the middle of recalibrating a repulsor.
units.italian: Mentre lo saluti, fai involontariamente trasalire Helm, che sta ricalibrando un repulsore.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"Woah! <first>! No need to sneak up on me!" He stands up to greet you. "What's new?"|11519|0
units.english: "Woah! <first>! No need to sneak up on me!" He stands up to greet you. "What's new?"
units.italian: "Whoa! <first>! Non serve sgusciarmi alle spalle!" Si alza a salutarti. "Che novità ci sono?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"Is Tosti around? I found his Family-Cairn and left the stone there."|11521|0
units.english: "Is Tosti around? I found his Family-Cairn and left the stone there."
units.italian: "Tosti è da queste parti? Ho trovato il suo Family-Cairn e ci ho lasciato la pietra."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"It's done. I chucked the stone out of a hatch, but it's at least on Hope now."|11525|0
units.english: "It's done. I chucked the stone out of a hatch, but it's at least on Hope now."
units.italian: "È fatto. Ho buttato la pietra fuori da un portello, ma almeno ora è su Hope."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"I threw the stone off a cliff, but it's at least on Hope now."|11529|0
units.english: "I threw the stone off a cliff, but it's at least on Hope now."
units.italian: "Ho gettato la pietra da una scogliera, ma almeno ora è su Hope."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"Where's Tosti?"|11533|0
units.english: "Where's Tosti?"
units.italian: "Dov'è Tosti?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"Ah, Tosti's out on the seas. The lad got himself a job working on a fishing trawler. It'll likely be a few years before he'll call to port here again."|11537|0
units.english: "Ah, Tosti's out on the seas. The lad got himself a job working on a fishing trawler. It'll likely be a few years before he'll call to port here again."
units.italian: "Ah, Tosti è in mare. Il ragazzo si è trovato un lavoro su un peschereccio. Probabilmente passeranno anni prima che torni a fare scalo qui."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	Helm gives you a friendly smile. "Still, you've done him a good turn. I'll have a message passed along to him so he knows he can rest easy."|11538|0
units.english: Helm gives you a friendly smile. "Still, you've done him a good turn. I'll have a message passed along to him so he knows he can rest easy."
units.italian: Helm ti rivolge un sorriso amichevole. "Comunque gli hai fatto un favore. Gli farò arrivare un messaggio, così saprà di poter stare tranquillo."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	He returns to tinkering with the repulsor but continues, "There's no money or reward, but word will spread and people here will appreciate it all the same. Here on Norn we have long memories."|11539|0
units.english: He returns to tinkering with the repulsor but continues, "There's no money or reward, but word will spread and people here will appreciate it all the same. Here on Norn we have long memories."
units.italian: Torna ad armeggiare con il repulsore ma continua: "Non ci sono soldi né ricompense, ma la voce si spargerà e la gente qui lo apprezzerà comunque. Su Norn abbiamo la memoria lunga."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	Helm stops what's he doing and looks up at you searchingly. "Best keep that to yourself, then. You of all people should know that folks around here take stone-bearing pretty seriously."|11546|0
units.english: Helm stops what's he doing and looks up at you searchingly. "Best keep that to yourself, then. You of all people should know that folks around here take stone-bearing pretty seriously."
units.italian: Helm interrompe quello che sta facendo e alza lo sguardo su di te, indagatore. "Allora è meglio che te lo tieni per te. Proprio tu dovresti sapere che qui la gente prende molto sul serio il portare le pietre."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	He sighs, "Still, better than not being on Hope at all, I suppose. As for Tosti, he's out on the seas. Got himself a job working on a fishing trawler. It'd likely be a few years before he'll call to port here again."|11547|0
units.english: He sighs, "Still, better than not being on Hope at all, I suppose. As for Tosti, he's out on the seas. Got himself a job working on a fishing trawler. It'd likely be a few years before he'll call to port here again."
units.italian: Sospira: "Comunque, meglio che non essere affatto su Hope, suppongo. Quanto a Tosti, è in mare. Si è trovato un lavoro su un peschereccio. Probabilmente passeranno anni prima che torni a fare scalo qui."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	He turns and looks out over Norn's endless oceans. "I'll have a message sent to him so he knows he can rest easy. I'll of course leave out the part about you tossing the stone. No reason to give him grief."|11548|0
units.english: He turns and looks out over Norn's endless oceans. "I'll have a message sent to him so he knows he can rest easy. I'll of course leave out the part about you tossing the stone. No reason to give him grief."
units.italian: Si volta e guarda gli oceani senza fine di Norn. "Gli farò mandare un messaggio, così saprà che può stare tranquillo. Ometterò ovviamente la parte in cui hai buttato la pietra. Non c'è motivo di dargli un dispiacere."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	He returns to tinkering with the repulsor but continues, "There's no money or reward, but a good deed is its own reward, isn't it?|11549|0
units.english: He returns to tinkering with the repulsor but continues, "There's no money or reward, but a good deed is its own reward, isn't it?
units.italian: Torna ad armeggiare con il repulsore ma continua: "Non ci sono soldi né ricompense, ma una buona azione è già la sua ricompensa, no?

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope: Thanks|	"At least that's what I believe," he says more to himself than to you.|11550|0
units.english: "At least that's what I believe," he says more to himself than to you.
units.italian: "Almeno, questo è quello che credo io," dice più a sé stesso che a te.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|name|11568|0
units.english: Siblings to New China
units.italian: Due fratelli per New China

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|description|11569|0
units.english: Bring these siblings to New China to hear their father's last will by <date>. They have offered to pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Porta questi fratelli su New China per ascoltare il testamento del padre entro <date>. Si sono offerti di pagarti <payment>.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|At night, the spaceport on <origin> livens up. There are porters running to and from depots with crates, crewmen buying rounds of drinks for each other around the bars before they hit the bed, and bands of Navy officers jovially greeting captains and systematically inspecting ships. The energy and self-purpose of this spaceport is on full display tonight.|11581|0
units.english: At night, the spaceport on <origin> livens up. There are porters running to and from depots with crates, crewmen buying rounds of drinks for each other around the bars before they hit the bed, and bands of Navy officers jovially greeting captains and systematically inspecting ships. The energy and self-purpose of this spaceport is on full display tonight.
units.italian: Di notte lo spazioporto di <origin> si anima. Ci sono facchini che corrono da e verso i depositi con le casse, membri dell'equipaggio che si offrono giri di bevande nei bar prima di andare a dormire, e gruppi di ufficiali della Marina che salutano giovialmente i capitani e ispezionano sistematicamente le navi. L'energia e la determinazione di questo spazioporto sono in bella mostra stasera.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	The only exception to the bustle and activity are a young man and woman, both dressed very formally, who are seemingly lost. You watch them drift from one person to another, each time being sent off without an answer. Finally, they come toward you.|11582|0
units.english: The only exception to the bustle and activity are a young man and woman, both dressed very formally, who are seemingly lost. You watch them drift from one person to another, each time being sent off without an answer. Finally, they come toward you.
units.italian: Le uniche eccezioni al trambusto e all'attività sono un giovane e una ragazza, entrambi vestiti molto formalmente, che sembrano smarriti. Li guardi passare da una persona all'altra, ogni volta congedati senza risposta. Alla fine si avvicinano a te.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	Their faces show clearly that they are on their last legs of hope. It is only with reluctance that the woman says, "Excuse me, are you a spaceship captain?"|11583|0
