units.english: Their faces show clearly that they are on their last legs of hope. It is only with reluctance that the woman says, "Excuse me, are you a spaceship captain?"
units.italian: I loro volti mostrano chiaramente che sono agli ultimi respiri di speranza. Solo con riluttanza la ragazza dice: "Mi scusi, lei è un capitano di nave?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Yes, my name's Captain <last>."|11585|0
units.english: "Yes, my name's Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Sì, sono il Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Depends on what you want."|11586|0
units.english: "Depends on what you want."
units.italian: "Dipende da quello che volete."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	Her face brightens up with a smile, and she continues, "That's good to hear! My brother and I were searching for someone who could give us a ride to <destination>. We received notice that our father's last will is going to be published there on <day>. Do you think you could take us there? We can pay you for your service, of course: <payment>."|11588|0
units.english: Her face brightens up with a smile, and she continues, "That's good to hear! My brother and I were searching for someone who could give us a ride to <destination>. We received notice that our father's last will is going to be published there on <day>. Do you think you could take us there? We can pay you for your service, of course: <payment>."
units.italian: Il viso le si illumina in un sorriso, e continua: "Che bello sentirlo! Mio fratello e io cercavamo qualcuno che potesse darci un passaggio fino a <destination>. Abbiamo ricevuto l'avviso che il testamento di nostro padre sarà pubblicato là il <day>. Pensa di poterci portare? Possiamo pagarla per il servizio, naturalmente: <payment>."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	She seems a little confused. "Oh, um... my brother and I were just searching for someone who could give us a ride to <destination>. We received notice that our father's last will is going to be published there on <day>. Do you think you could take us there? We can pay you for your service, of course: <payment>.|11591|0
units.english: She seems a little confused. "Oh, um... my brother and I were just searching for someone who could give us a ride to <destination>. We received notice that our father's last will is going to be published there on <day>. Do you think you could take us there? We can pay you for your service, of course: <payment>.
units.italian: Sembra un po' confusa. "Oh, ehm... mio fratello e io cercavamo solo qualcuno che potesse darci un passaggio fino a <destination>. Abbiamo ricevuto l'avviso che il testamento di nostro padre sarà pubblicato là il <day>. Pensa di poterci portare? Possiamo pagarla per il servizio, naturalmente: <payment>.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|label|11592|0
units.english: help or not
units.italian: help or not

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Of course I can."|11594|0
units.english: "Of course I can."
units.italian: "Certo che posso."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"I'm sorry, but I've got more urgent things to do. You'll need to find someone else."|11596|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I've got more urgent things to do. You'll need to find someone else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma ho cose più urgenti da fare. Dovete trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	Her smile fades away as you say that, but they both simply nod and walk out of the spaceport with their heads down.|11597|0
units.english: Her smile fades away as you say that, but they both simply nod and walk out of the spaceport with their heads down.
units.italian: Il suo sorriso svanisce mentre lo dici, ma annuiscono entrambi e se ne vanno dallo spazioporto a testa bassa.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Fantastic! My name is Sophie, and this is my younger brother," she says, pointing at the man to her side, who goes to shake your hand.|11600|0
units.english: "Fantastic! My name is Sophie, and this is my younger brother," she says, pointing at the man to her side, who goes to shake your hand.
units.italian: "Fantastico! Mi chiamo Sophie, e lui è mio fratello minore," dice, indicando l'uomo accanto a lei, che ti tende la mano.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Hi, I'm Liam. We've been looking for a ride for some time now. We were starting to worry that we wouldn't get there in time! You'll have to bring us there quickly."|11601|0
units.english: "Hi, I'm Liam. We've been looking for a ride for some time now. We were starting to worry that we wouldn't get there in time! You'll have to bring us there quickly."
units.italian: "Ciao, sono Liam. È da un po' che cerchiamo un passaggio. Cominciavamo a temere di non arrivare in tempo! Dovrà portarci là in fretta."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Don't worry, you'll be surprised how fast my ship flies. We'll get there in no time."|11603|0
units.english: "Don't worry, you'll be surprised how fast my ship flies. We'll get there in no time."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, resterai sorpreso di quanto vada veloce la mia nave. Arriveremo in un lampo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"Yes, a lot of captains are quite busy these days."|11605|0
units.english: "Yes, a lot of captains are quite busy these days."
units.italian: "Sì, molti capitani sono piuttosto impegnati in questi giorni."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	"It seems that way," Sophie agrees. "Everyone feels more tense or uncertain. There's always more to do and less time to do it."|11606|0
units.english: "It seems that way," Sophie agrees. "Everyone feels more tense or uncertain. There's always more to do and less time to do it."
units.italian: "Sembra proprio così," concorda Sophie. "Tutti si sentono più tesi o incerti. C'è sempre di più da fare e meno tempo per farlo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|label|11608|0
units.english: no time
units.italian: no time

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	Liam's voice barely hides his excitement at finding an available captain. "Well, let's see that ship of yours then, and show us if it's as fast as you say it is!"|11609|0
units.english: Liam's voice barely hides his excitement at finding an available captain. "Well, let's see that ship of yours then, and show us if it's as fast as you say it is!"
units.italian: La voce di Liam nasconde a stento l'eccitazione per aver trovato un capitano disponibile. "Bene, allora facci vedere questa tua nave, e mostraci se è veloce come dici!"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|	You lead them to your ship and help them with their bags as they board.|11611|0
units.english: You lead them to your ship and help them with their bags as they board.
units.italian: Li guidi alla nave e li aiuti con i bagagli mentre salgono.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|log|11616|0
units.english: Helped a pair of siblings named Sophie and Liam by bringing them to New China so they can hear their father's last will.
units.italian: Ho aiutato due fratelli, Sophie e Liam, portandoli su New China perché potessero ascoltare il testamento del padre.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 1|When you arrive at <planet>'s spaceport, the siblings prepare to head off to the court where their father's last will will be read out. Just before they leave, Liam turns to you. "Captain <last>, I've transferred <payment> to your account. Would it be okay for you to wait here until we come back? We'll need a ride home. If you're able to take us, please meet us in the spaceport later."|11618|0
units.english: When you arrive at <planet>'s spaceport, the siblings prepare to head off to the court where their father's last will will be read out. Just before they leave, Liam turns to you. "Captain <last>, I've transferred <payment> to your account. Would it be okay for you to wait here until we come back? We'll need a ride home. If you're able to take us, please meet us in the spaceport later."
units.italian: Quando arrivi allo spazioporto di <planet>, i fratelli si preparano ad andare al tribunale dove sarà letto il testamento del padre. Poco prima di uscire, Liam si volta verso di te. "Capitano <last>, ho trasferito <payment> sul suo conto. Potrebbe aspettare qui finché non torniamo? Ci servirà un passaggio a casa. Se può portarci, ci trovi allo spazioporto più tardi."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|name|11622|0
units.english: Following Footprints
units.italian: Seguendo le impronte

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|description|11623|0
units.english: Bring Sophie and Liam through <waypoints>, before finally bringing them to <destination>. They will pay you another <payment>.
units.italian: Porta Sophie e Liam attraverso <waypoints>, prima di accompagnarli infine su <destination>. Ti pagheranno altri <payment>.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|After waiting two hours in the spaceport's bar, Liam and Sophie come back with unexpectedly broad smiles on their faces. You flag them down from your table and they eagerly take a seat.|11635|0
units.english: After waiting two hours in the spaceport's bar, Liam and Sophie come back with unexpectedly broad smiles on their faces. You flag them down from your table and they eagerly take a seat.
units.italian: Dopo due ore di attesa nel bar dello spazioporto, Liam e Sophie tornano con sorrisi inaspettatamente larghi sul viso. Li chiami con un cenno dal tuo tavolo e si siedono con entusiasmo.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam speaks as soon as he can. "Captain <last>, it turns out we will need a bit more than just a ride home! Have you decided to help us again?"|11636|0
units.english: Liam speaks as soon as he can. "Captain <last>, it turns out we will need a bit more than just a ride home! Have you decided to help us again?"
units.italian: Liam parla appena può. "Capitano <last>, a quanto pare ci servirà un po' più di un passaggio a casa! Ha deciso di aiutarci ancora?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"What do you want me to do?"|11638|0
units.english: "What do you want me to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete che faccia?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Tell me more before I decide."|11639|0
units.english: "Tell me more before I decide."
units.italian: "Dimmi di più prima che decida."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Sophie smiles at her brother. "Of course, Liam just can't wait to get started!" She turns back to you. "Maybe I should start with who our father was. We didn't get to know him very well - he came home only occasionally. Don't get me wrong, our parents weren't fighting, but he had this passion: he couldn't stay in one place for very long. He was a captain, not unlike you, and he was restless to explore even the furthest parts of the galaxy. We believe he traveled further than most human captains; sometimes he brought small items back home that nobody could explain."|11640|0
units.english: Sophie smiles at her brother. "Of course, Liam just can't wait to get started!" She turns back to you. "Maybe I should start with who our father was. We didn't get to know him very well - he came home only occasionally. Don't get me wrong, our parents weren't fighting, but he had this passion: he couldn't stay in one place for very long. He was a captain, not unlike you, and he was restless to explore even the furthest parts of the galaxy. We believe he traveled further than most human captains; sometimes he brought small items back home that nobody could explain."
units.italian: Sophie sorride al fratello. "Certo, Liam non vede l'ora di cominciare!" Poi torna a guardarti. "Forse dovrei cominciare da chi era nostro padre. Non abbiamo avuto modo di conoscerlo bene: tornava a casa solo ogni tanto. Non fraintendermi, i nostri genitori non litigavano, ma lui aveva questa passione: non riusciva a restare a lungo nello stesso posto. Era un capitano, non diverso da te, e irrequieto nell'esplorare anche le parti più remote della galassia. Crediamo che abbia viaggiato più lontano della maggior parte dei capitani umani; a volte portava a casa piccoli oggetti che nessuno sapeva spiegare."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	She pauses for a moment. "Anyway, his testament says he left something behind for us on <planet>, in <system>. He said that he wouldn't make it easy though; he loved fantasy books, and there's always an air of mystery to those stories. He told us of a few systems we should visit before we go to Prime. It'll be like one last fantasy story from Dad!|11641|0
units.english: She pauses for a moment. "Anyway, his testament says he left something behind for us on <planet>, in <system>. He said that he wouldn't make it easy though; he loved fantasy books, and there's always an air of mystery to those stories. He told us of a few systems we should visit before we go to Prime. It'll be like one last fantasy story from Dad!
units.italian: Si ferma un momento. "Comunque, il suo testamento dice che ci ha lasciato qualcosa su <planet>, in <system>. Diceva però che non l'avrebbe reso facile; amava i libri fantasy, e c'è sempre un'aria di mistero in quelle storie. Ci ha indicato alcuni sistemi da visitare prima di andare su Prime. Sarà come un'ultima storia fantasy di papà!

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Of course, it would be much easier if we could go directly to Prime, but we want to respect our father's last will." She looks directly at you now. "And that is why we need your help. Could you help us again and take us through all these systems?"|11642|0
units.english: "Of course, it would be much easier if we could go directly to Prime, but we want to respect our father's last will." She looks directly at you now. "And that is why we need your help. Could you help us again and take us through all these systems?"
units.italian: "Certo, sarebbe molto più facile andare direttamente su Prime, ma vogliamo rispettare l'ultimo volere di nostro padre." Ora ti guarda dritto. "Ed è per questo che ci serve il tuo aiuto. Potresti aiutarci ancora e portarci attraverso tutti questi sistemi?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Which systems would we have to fly through?"|11644|0
units.english: "Which systems would we have to fly through?"
units.italian: "Attraverso quali sistemi dovremmo passare?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"I'm sorry, but that sounds too complicated to me."|11645|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but that sounds too complicated to me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma mi sembra troppo complicato."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam pulls a star map out of his bag. "These are the systems our father wants us to visit: <waypoints>. Those systems are spread far out around human space, but apparently they all have something unique to them. We've never really traveled beyond our home planet, so it'll be quite a big adventure for us! We can offer 50,000 credits. Does that sound good?"|11648|0
units.english: Liam pulls a star map out of his bag. "These are the systems our father wants us to visit: <waypoints>. Those systems are spread far out around human space, but apparently they all have something unique to them. We've never really traveled beyond our home planet, so it'll be quite a big adventure for us! We can offer 50,000 credits. Does that sound good?"
units.italian: Liam tira fuori dalla borsa una carta stellare. "Questi sono i sistemi che nostro padre vuole che visitiamo: <waypoints>. Sono sparsi lontano intorno allo spazio umano, ma a quanto pare ognuno ha qualcosa di unico. Non abbiamo mai viaggiato davvero oltre il nostro pianeta natale, quindi sarà una bella avventura per noi! Possiamo offrire 50.000 crediti. Ti sembra bene?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Sounds good!"|11650|0
units.english: "Sounds good!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene!"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Sorry, I won't be able to take you. Those systems are too far away from each other."|11651|0
units.english: "Sorry, I won't be able to take you. Those systems are too far away from each other."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non potrò portarvi. Quei sistemi sono troppo distanti l'uno dall'altro."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Great! We weren't expecting this trip, so we'll need to buy some supplies," Sophie says, "but as soon as you're ready we'll be on board."|11653|0
units.english: "Great! We weren't expecting this trip, so we'll need to buy some supplies," Sophie says, "but as soon as you're ready we'll be on board."
units.italian: "Ottimo! Non ci aspettavamo questo viaggio, quindi dovremo comprare delle provviste," dice Sophie, "ma appena sei pronto saremo a bordo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|label|11656|0
units.english: no thanks
units.italian: no thanks

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Well, it looks like we'll need to find somebody else," Sophie says. They both thank you for bringing them this far and walk away.|11657|0
units.english: "Well, it looks like we'll need to find somebody else," Sophie says. They both thank you for bringing them this far and walk away.
units.italian: "Beh, pare che dovremo trovare qualcun altro," dice Sophie. Vi ringraziano entrambi per averli portati fin qui e se ne vanno.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|dialog|11661|0
units.english: It is often thought that there's nothing interesting in these uninhabited systems by the Deep, but Sophie points out that there is a strange anomaly in this system. "When we got to see him, our father used to describe all these unusual sights he saw on his adventures flying through wormholes or nebulae. That anomaly reminds me of one of them."
units.italian: Si pensa spesso che in questi sistemi disabitati vicino al Deep non ci sia nulla di interessante, ma Sophie fa notare che in questo sistema c'è una strana anomalia. "Quando riuscivamo a vederlo, nostro padre descriveva tutte le cose insolite che vedeva nelle sue avventure, volando attraverso wormhole o nebulose. Quell'anomalia me ne ricorda una."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|dialog|11663|0
units.english: While Sophie and Liam are both quite chatty at times, the beauty of this star stops all their conversations.
units.italian: Anche se Sophie e Liam a volte sono piuttosto loquaci, la bellezza di questa stella ferma tutte le loro conversazioni.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|dialog|11665|0
units.english: Approaching the nebula surrounding Gorvi, Sophie and Liam both chatter to each other about the marvels and mysteries of the Wolf-Rayet star at its center.
units.italian: Avvicinandovi alla nebulosa che circonda Gorvi, Sophie e Liam chiacchierano fra loro delle meraviglie e dei misteri della stella Wolf-Rayet al suo centro.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|dialog|11667|0
units.english: If there was ever a prime example of how much the human race still has to learn, it is the strange, impressive, and yet still unfinished ringworld in this system. Liam tells you, "Our father was a very curious man, and he always talked about the Quarg and their ringworlds, and how it would be another thousand years before humanity could build anything similar. We've never seen how big it was until now!"
units.italian: Se mai c'è stato un esempio lampante di quanto l'umanità debba ancora imparare, è lo strano, impressionante e ancora incompiuto mondo ad anello in questo sistema. Liam ti dice: "Nostro padre era un uomo molto curioso e parlava sempre dei Quarg e dei loro mondi ad anello, e di come sarebbe passato un altro migliaio di anni prima che l'umanità potesse costruire qualcosa di simile. Non avevamo mai visto quanto fossero grandi fino ad ora!"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|log|11673|0
units.english: Brought Sophie and Liam to various locations that their departed father asked them to visit in his will; ended at Prime where he left something for them.
units.italian: Ho portato Sophie e Liam in vari luoghi che il loro padre defunto aveva chiesto di visitare nel testamento; si è concluso su Prime, dove ha lasciato qualcosa per loro.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|The siblings are uncharacteristically quiet, perhaps in anticipation of finally arriving at their destination. It is only when you have all stepped out into Prime's spaceport that Sophie says, "Captain <last>, you've helped us immensely, and we can't thank you enough for bringing us all across the galaxy! But we have one last request. Both of us think that you should come with us to see what our father left behind. Do you want to see it?"|11675|0
units.english: The siblings are uncharacteristically quiet, perhaps in anticipation of finally arriving at their destination. It is only when you have all stepped out into Prime's spaceport that Sophie says, "Captain <last>, you've helped us immensely, and we can't thank you enough for bringing us all across the galaxy! But we have one last request. Both of us think that you should come with us to see what our father left behind. Do you want to see it?"
units.italian: I fratelli sono insolitamente silenziosi, forse in attesa di arrivare finalmente a destinazione. Solo quando siete tutti scesi nello spazioporto di Prime Sophie dice: "Capitano <last>, ci ha aiutato immensamente, e non sapremo mai ringraziarla abbastanza per averci portato attraverso la galassia! Ma abbiamo un'ultima richiesta. Entrambi pensiamo che dovrebbe venire con noi a vedere che cosa ha lasciato nostro padre. Vuole vederlo?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Now that we've come so far, sure."|11677|0
units.english: "Now that we've come so far, sure."
units.italian: "Ormai siamo arrivati fin qui, certo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"I'm sorry, I've got to be somewhere else."|11678|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I've got to be somewhere else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, devo essere altrove."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam pulls out a map - not the starmap he had before, but a local map of Prime marked 'New Toulouse'. "Apparently our father bought a whole mountain on this planet, and he wants us to go there. It's to the west of us near the New Pyrenees, a little while away from the spaceport."|11680|0
units.english: Liam pulls out a map - not the starmap he had before, but a local map of Prime marked 'New Toulouse'. "Apparently our father bought a whole mountain on this planet, and he wants us to go there. It's to the west of us near the New Pyrenees, a little while away from the spaceport."
units.italian: Liam tira fuori una mappa: non la carta stellare di prima, ma una mappa locale di Prime con la scritta 'New Toulouse'. "A quanto pare nostro padre ha comprato un'intera montagna su questo pianeta, e vuole che andiamo là. È a ovest da noi, vicino ai New Pyrenees, a un po' di distanza dallo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Sounds good. I'll follow your lead."|11682|0
units.english: "Sounds good. I'll follow your lead."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Vi seguo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"We could also have a look around here, and see why your father chose this planet."|11684|0
units.english: "We could also have a look around here, and see why your father chose this planet."
units.italian: "Potremmo anche dare un'occhiata qui intorno, e capire perché vostro padre ha scelto questo pianeta."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"You're right. I hadn't thought of that, surely there was a reason he picked here," Sophie says.|11685|0
units.english: "You're right. I hadn't thought of that, surely there was a reason he picked here," Sophie says.
units.italian: "Hai ragione. Non ci avevo pensato, di sicuro c'era un motivo se ha scelto proprio qui," dice Sophie.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	All three of you walk around the spaceport district for some time. Coming into a giant plaza, you see one of the newest models from Betelgeuse, a Behemoth, on display in the center. The massive freighter with its many turret emplacements towers over even the plaza, an obvious showcase of Prime's leading shipbuilding industry.|11686|0
units.english: All three of you walk around the spaceport district for some time. Coming into a giant plaza, you see one of the newest models from Betelgeuse, a Behemoth, on display in the center. The massive freighter with its many turret emplacements towers over even the plaza, an obvious showcase of Prime's leading shipbuilding industry.
units.italian: Camminate tutti e tre per un po' nel distretto dello spazioporto. Arrivando in una piazza enorme, vedete al centro uno dei modelli più recenti della Betelgeuse, un Behemoth, in esposizione. L'imponente mercantile con le sue numerose torrette torreggia persino sulla piazza, una vetrina evidente dell'industria cantieristica leader di Prime.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam's face brightens as if he just understood something. "I think our father chose this planet because he was always a fan of Betelgeuse ships. Before he went on his adventures he used to be a test pilot for the shipyard."|11687|0
units.english: Liam's face brightens as if he just understood something. "I think our father chose this planet because he was always a fan of Betelgeuse ships. Before he went on his adventures he used to be a test pilot for the shipyard."
units.italian: Il viso di Liam si illumina come se avesse appena capito qualcosa. "Credo che nostro padre abbia scelto questo pianeta perché è sempre stato un fan delle navi Betelgeuse. Prima delle sue avventure faceva il pilota collaudatore per il cantiere."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Sophie nods. "Right! And once he was allowed to keep one of their experimental models as a gift for being one of their most productive pilots. Betelgeuse almost wouldn't let him go when he wanted to leave and explore the galaxy! But we're running out of time. Shall we go to the mountain now?"|11688|0
units.english: Sophie nods. "Right! And once he was allowed to keep one of their experimental models as a gift for being one of their most productive pilots. Betelgeuse almost wouldn't let him go when he wanted to leave and explore the galaxy! But we're running out of time. Shall we go to the mountain now?"
units.italian: Sophie annuisce. "Esatto! E una volta gli fu permesso di tenere uno dei loro modelli sperimentali come regalo per essere stato uno dei loro piloti più produttivi. La Betelgeuse quasi non lo lasciò andare quando volle partire per esplorare la galassia! Ma stiamo perdendo tempo. Andiamo alla montagna adesso?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"We should take a shuttle. It'll be the fastest way."|11690|0
units.english: "We should take a shuttle. It'll be the fastest way."
units.italian: "Dovremmo prendere una navetta. È il modo più veloce."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Let's take the maglev, we should make it before it gets dark."|11691|0
units.english: "Let's take the maglev, we should make it before it gets dark."
units.italian: "Prendiamo il maglev, dovremmo arrivare prima che faccia buio."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	After a short shuttlecraft flight on Prime's extensive and well-maintained shuttle service, you and the siblings arrive at a provincial city, where you can see a small mountain that stands alone against the rest of the landscape.|11694|0
units.english: After a short shuttlecraft flight on Prime's extensive and well-maintained shuttle service, you and the siblings arrive at a provincial city, where you can see a small mountain that stands alone against the rest of the landscape.
units.italian: Dopo un breve volo in navetta sul servizio esteso e ben tenuto di Prime, tu e i fratelli arrivate a una città di provincia, dove vedete una piccola montagna che si erge da sola rispetto al resto del paesaggio.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	You take a maglev from the spaceport and get a tour through some of the regions of Prime's mainland; on the way you pass through the fields of New Toulouse, where the majority of the local agricultural industry is located, and into the New Pyrenees hills. After an hour you and the siblings step off at a provincial city. Although Betelgeuse starts to recede behind the horizon, you can see a small mountain that stands alone against the rest of the landscape.|11697|0
units.english: You take a maglev from the spaceport and get a tour through some of the regions of Prime's mainland; on the way you pass through the fields of New Toulouse, where the majority of the local agricultural industry is located, and into the New Pyrenees hills. After an hour you and the siblings step off at a provincial city. Although Betelgeuse starts to recede behind the horizon, you can see a small mountain that stands alone against the rest of the landscape.
units.italian: Prendi un maglev dallo spazioporto e fai un giro attraverso alcune regioni della terraferma di Prime; lungo la strada passi per i campi di New Toulouse, dove si trova la maggior parte dell'industria agricola locale, e poi nelle colline dei New Pyrenees. Dopo un'ora tu e i fratelli scendete a una città di provincia. Anche se la Betelgeuse comincia a sparire dietro l'orizzonte, vedete una piccola montagna che si erge da sola rispetto al resto del paesaggio.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam, with the help of the map, guides all of you to the base of the mountain, where you come across a flat wall embedded into a small cavern in its side. "There's a phrase our father left in the instructions: 'Edr- i fen,'" he explains, a little embarrassed at his inability to pronounce it. "I don't know what it means, but I'm certain it has something to do with one of these fantasy novels he used to read."|11699|0
units.english: Liam, with the help of the map, guides all of you to the base of the mountain, where you come across a flat wall embedded into a small cavern in its side. "There's a phrase our father left in the instructions: 'Edr- i fen,'" he explains, a little embarrassed at his inability to pronounce it. "I don't know what it means, but I'm certain it has something to do with one of these fantasy novels he used to read."
units.italian: Liam, con l'aiuto della mappa, vi guida tutti alla base della montagna, dove trovate una parete piatta incassata in una piccola caverna sul fianco. "C'è una frase che nostro padre ha lasciato nelle istruzioni: 'Edr- i fen'," spiega, un po' imbarazzato dalla sua incapacità di pronunciarla. "Non so che cosa significhi, ma sono certo che abbia a che fare con uno di quei romanzi fantasy che leggeva."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Sounds funny, but let's say it."|11701|0
units.english: "Sounds funny, but let's say it."
units.italian: "Suona buffo, ma diciamola."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"You've got a strange dad, but I like his sense of humor."|11702|0
units.english: "You've got a strange dad, but I like his sense of humor."
units.italian: "Hai un padre strano, ma mi piace il suo senso dell'umorismo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Sophie counts to three, and then all of you shout out the phrase together.|11703|0
units.english: Sophie counts to three, and then all of you shout out the phrase together.
units.italian: Sophie conta fino a tre, e poi pronunciate tutti insieme la frase.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Suddenly, a bright blue line appears on the wall. For a second, a flash blinds you and there is a dim hissing noise, like the sound of rock being cut by a laser. As you look back, the line forms into a blue rectangle, the shape rapidly expanding down the wall. When it reaches the ground, the shape has become large enough to cover a human.|11704|0
units.english: Suddenly, a bright blue line appears on the wall. For a second, a flash blinds you and there is a dim hissing noise, like the sound of rock being cut by a laser. As you look back, the line forms into a blue rectangle, the shape rapidly expanding down the wall. When it reaches the ground, the shape has become large enough to cover a human.
units.italian: All'improvviso sulla parete compare una linea blu brillante. Per un secondo un lampo ti acceca e si sente un sibilo fioco, come il rumore di una roccia tagliata da un laser. Quando torni a guardare, la linea forma un rettangolo blu, la cui sagoma si allarga rapidamente lungo la parete. Quando raggiunge il suolo, la forma è abbastanza grande da coprire una persona.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	For a moment, nothing happens, and the siblings are too stunned to do anything. The rectangle starts flashing between different hues of blue, until the whole section and the stone it covered disappears suddenly to leave behind a cavity in the wall. "I could have sworn the stone was real," Liam says under his breath.|11705|0
units.english: For a moment, nothing happens, and the siblings are too stunned to do anything. The rectangle starts flashing between different hues of blue, until the whole section and the stone it covered disappears suddenly to leave behind a cavity in the wall. "I could have sworn the stone was real," Liam says under his breath.
units.italian: Per un momento non succede nulla, e i fratelli sono troppo stupiti per fare qualcosa. Il rettangolo comincia a lampeggiare fra diverse tonalità di blu, finché l'intera sezione e la pietra che copriva non scompaiono all'improvviso, lasciando una cavità nella parete. "Avrei giurato che la pietra fosse vera," dice Liam a bassa voce.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Well, this is a real adventure. Let's go!"|11707|0
units.english: "Well, this is a real adventure. Let's go!"
units.italian: "Beh, questa è una vera avventura. Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"We don't know what's inside there. Be careful."|11709|0
units.english: "We don't know what's inside there. Be careful."
units.italian: "Non sappiamo che cosa c'è là dentro. Stai attento."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Well, now that you mention it, I recently bought a small camera drone," Liam responds. "We can use it to scout out the hallway. It's only in infrared, so we won't see too many details," he adds. Liam starts the drone and guides it using a small remote control with integrated display. After some time, the drone flies back out and he tells you, "I think it is safe. We can go."|11710|0
units.english: "Well, now that you mention it, I recently bought a small camera drone," Liam responds. "We can use it to scout out the hallway. It's only in infrared, so we won't see too many details," he adds. Liam starts the drone and guides it using a small remote control with integrated display. After some time, the drone flies back out and he tells you, "I think it is safe. We can go."
units.italian: "Beh, ora che lo dici, ho comprato di recente un piccolo drone con telecamera," risponde Liam. "Possiamo usarlo per esplorare il corridoio. È solo a infrarossi, quindi non vedremo molti dettagli," aggiunge. Liam avvia il drone e lo guida con un piccolo telecomando con display integrato. Dopo un po' il drone torna fuori e lui ti dice: "Credo che sia sicuro. Possiamo andare."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	In single file, the three of you enter the hallway behind the opening. Strangely, the stone walls are perfectly smooth, and the light that guides you through seems to come out of nowhere. "To use alien technology for something like this," Sophie laughs, "that's totally our dad."|11712|0
units.english: In single file, the three of you enter the hallway behind the opening. Strangely, the stone walls are perfectly smooth, and the light that guides you through seems to come out of nowhere. "To use alien technology for something like this," Sophie laughs, "that's totally our dad."
units.italian: In fila indiana entrate tutti e tre nel corridoio dietro l'apertura. Stranamente le pareti di pietra sono perfettamente lisce, e la luce che vi guida sembra venire dal nulla. "Usare tecnologia aliena per una cosa del genere," ride Sophie, "è proprio da nostro padre."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	For a long while the three of you continue through the stone hallway, the light following your movements, until it opens up into a dome-shaped room brilliantly bathed in blue light. On the walls, there are all manner of alien artifacts lined up next to each other, but at the center of the room there is a pedestal with a sword inserted into it. A small tablet stands in a socket in front of it.|11713|0
units.english: For a long while the three of you continue through the stone hallway, the light following your movements, until it opens up into a dome-shaped room brilliantly bathed in blue light. On the walls, there are all manner of alien artifacts lined up next to each other, but at the center of the room there is a pedestal with a sword inserted into it. A small tablet stands in a socket in front of it.
units.italian: Per un bel tratto proseguite tutti e tre nel corridoio di pietra, con la luce che segue i vostri movimenti, finché non si apre in una stanza a cupola immersa in una luce blu brillante. Sulle pareti ci sono manufatti alieni di ogni tipo allineati l'uno accanto all'altro, ma al centro della stanza c'è un piedistallo con una spada conficcata. Davanti c'è una piccola tavoletta incastrata in una fessura.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	(Go up to the sword.)|11715|0
units.english: (Go up to the sword.)
units.italian: (Vai verso la spada.)

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	(Take a look around first.)|11717|0
units.english: (Take a look around first.)
units.italian: (Dai prima un'occhiata in giro.)

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	You walk around to the right of the dome to the collection of alien objects, all steel in color and rather blocky. "Wow, he must have always brought us back the small items from his expeditions, because these artifacts over here are huge!" Liam exclaims from another part of the dome. "How did he even move all these here?"|11718|0
units.english: You walk around to the right of the dome to the collection of alien objects, all steel in color and rather blocky. "Wow, he must have always brought us back the small items from his expeditions, because these artifacts over here are huge!" Liam exclaims from another part of the dome. "How did he even move all these here?"
units.italian: Giri alla destra della cupola verso la collezione di oggetti alieni, tutti color acciaio e piuttosto tozzi. "Wow, a noi avrà sempre riportato gli oggetti piccoli dalle sue spedizioni, perché questi manufatti qui sono enormi!" esclama Liam da un'altra parte della cupola. "Come ha fatto a spostarli tutti fin qui?"

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Now that Liam points it out, many of the larger artifacts over his way look similar to the Sheragi technology you studied with Albert Foster.|11719|0
units.english: Now that Liam points it out, many of the larger artifacts over his way look similar to the Sheragi technology you studied with Albert Foster.
units.italian: Ora che Liam lo fa notare, molti dei manufatti più grandi dalla sua parte somigliano alla tecnologia Sheragi che hai studiato con Albert Foster.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	After some time, Sophie calls you both to come and look at the tablet.|11722|0
units.english: After some time, Sophie calls you both to come and look at the tablet.
units.italian: Dopo un po' Sophie vi chiama entrambi a guardare la tavoletta.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	(Go over to Sophie.)|11724|0
units.english: (Go over to Sophie.)
units.italian: (Vai da Sophie.)

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|label|11725|0
units.english: sword scene
units.italian: sword scene

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	A short message, written on the tablet in green ink, appears as you approach:|11726|0
units.english: A short message, written on the tablet in green ink, appears as you approach:
units.italian: Un breve messaggio, scritto sulla tavoletta con inchiostro verde, compare mentre ti avvicini:

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|			"My dear children. The galaxy runs far and wide, and I have traveled many places, more than most in many lifetimes. I have seen many worlds, both alien and human, too. It was my life's work.|11727|0
units.english: "My dear children. The galaxy runs far and wide, and I have traveled many places, more than most in many lifetimes. I have seen many worlds, both alien and human, too. It was my life's work.
units.italian: "Miei cari figli. La galassia si estende ampia e vasta, e ho viaggiato in molti luoghi, più della maggior parte delle persone in molte vite. Ho visto molti mondi, alieni e umani. È stata l'opera della mia vita.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|			"But still, there were many paths I did not take, many rocks I have left unturned, and many worlds I have not yet landed on. And I suspect that you will have read this before those destinations were reached. Well, I have arrived at a different destination now, the only one nobody can understand, but everybody reaches eventually. Do not fear for me.|11728|0
units.english: "But still, there were many paths I did not take, many rocks I have left unturned, and many worlds I have not yet landed on. And I suspect that you will have read this before those destinations were reached. Well, I have arrived at a different destination now, the only one nobody can understand, but everybody reaches eventually. Do not fear for me.
units.italian: "Eppure c'erano ancora molti sentieri che non ho preso, molte pietre che non ho girato e molti mondi su cui non sono ancora atterrato. E sospetto che leggerete questo prima che quelle destinazioni siano raggiunte. Beh, ora sono arrivato a una destinazione diversa, l'unica che nessuno può capire, ma che tutti raggiungono prima o poi. Non temete per me.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|			"This room you are in now is the culmination of all my work. I hope you understand that it was for your sake that I kept these a secret. My journey was long and unforgiving, but it was my life. I hope you continue that journey, to understand the universe a little better.|11729|0
units.english: "This room you are in now is the culmination of all my work. I hope you understand that it was for your sake that I kept these a secret. My journey was long and unforgiving, but it was my life. I hope you continue that journey, to understand the universe a little better.
units.italian: "La stanza in cui siete ora è il culmine di tutto il mio lavoro. Spero capiate che è stato per voi che ho tenuto queste cose segrete. Il mio viaggio è stato lungo e severo, ma è stata la mia vita. Spero che continuiate quel viaggio, per capire un po' meglio l'universo.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|			"Your father."|11730|0
units.english: "Your father."
units.italian: "Vostro padre."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Understanding the personal nature of the message, you leave the two alone for a bit, walking around and looking at the artifacts on the left of the dome.|11731|0
units.english: Understanding the personal nature of the message, you leave the two alone for a bit, walking around and looking at the artifacts on the left of the dome.
units.italian: Capendo la natura personale del messaggio, lasci i due soli per un po', girando e guardando i manufatti alla sinistra della cupola.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	After some time, the siblings call you back. Sophie says, "Captain <last>, Liam and I have thought about this, and we think that we would never be able to live up to our father's expectations if we kept this sword. We can study all these artifacts and understand more about the universe through them, but we cannot study this one. To understand its abilities, it needs to be used.|11732|0
units.english: After some time, the siblings call you back. Sophie says, "Captain <last>, Liam and I have thought about this, and we think that we would never be able to live up to our father's expectations if we kept this sword. We can study all these artifacts and understand more about the universe through them, but we cannot study this one. To understand its abilities, it needs to be used.
units.italian: Dopo un po' i fratelli ti richiamano. Sophie dice: "Capitano <last>, Liam e io ci abbiamo pensato, e crediamo che non saremmo mai all'altezza delle aspettative di nostro padre se tenessimo questa spada. Possiamo studiare tutti questi manufatti e capire di più sull'universo attraverso di loro, ma non possiamo studiare questa. Per capirne le capacità, bisogna usarla.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"This sword was always at our father's side, and it has been many places. Take it to many more." She pulls the sword from the pedestal, and gives it one last look before handing over it to you. "It is yours now."|11733|0
units.english: "This sword was always at our father's side, and it has been many places. Take it to many more." She pulls the sword from the pedestal, and gives it one last look before handing over it to you. "It is yours now."
units.italian: "Questa spada è sempre stata al fianco di nostro padre, ed è stata in molti luoghi. Portala in molti altri." Estrae la spada dal piedistallo e le dà un ultimo sguardo prima di consegnartela. "Ora è tua."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"I would be more than grateful to accept it."|11735|0
units.english: "I would be more than grateful to accept it."
units.italian: "Sarei più che grato di accettarla."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"This is too much for me to take."|11737|0
units.english: "This is too much for me to take."
units.italian: "È troppo perché io la prenda."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Are you sure?" Sophie asks. "This is a one time offer. It would be wasted on us."|11738|0
units.english: "Are you sure?" Sophie asks. "This is a one time offer. It would be wasted on us."
units.italian: "Ne sei sicura?" chiede Sophie. "È un'offerta irripetibile. Sarebbe sprecata con noi."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Yes, I'm sure."|11740|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm sure."
units.italian: "Sì, ne sono sicuro."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Well, if you frame it that way, I'll take it."|11742|0
units.english: "Well, if you frame it that way, I'll take it."
units.italian: "Beh, se la metti così, la prendo."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	You take the strange sword from Sophie. It seems abnormally light, but maybe that's because you've never held a sword before.|11747|0
units.english: You take the strange sword from Sophie. It seems abnormally light, but maybe that's because you've never held a sword before.
units.italian: Prendi la strana spada da Sophie. Sembra anormalmente leggera, ma forse è perché non hai mai impugnato una spada prima.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"I see... please, if you won't take our father's sword, take an extra payment for having to put up with us all the way up until now." She takes the sword away and inserts it back into the pedestal.|11753|0
units.english: "I see... please, if you won't take our father's sword, take an extra payment for having to put up with us all the way up until now." She takes the sword away and inserts it back into the pedestal.
units.italian: "Capisco... per favore, se non vuole la spada di nostro padre, prenda un pagamento extra per averci sopportato fino a questo momento." Riprende la spada e la rimette nel piedistallo.

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	"Well, we'll need some time to take it all in and arrange things, find a place to stay on Prime and all that," Sophie says, "but we won't keep you from your ship any longer. It was a pleasure to travel with you, Captain <last>."|11756|0
units.english: "Well, we'll need some time to take it all in and arrange things, find a place to stay on Prime and all that," Sophie says, "but we won't keep you from your ship any longer. It was a pleasure to travel with you, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Beh, ci servirà un po' di tempo per assimilarlo e sistemare le cose, trovare un posto dove stare su Prime e tutto il resto," dice Sophie, "ma non la tratteniamo oltre la sua nave. È stato un piacere viaggiare con lei, Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:A Dead Man's Path 2|	Liam adds, "We will always be grateful for your help with our father's will. We never imagined that we would come so far, and we would have never done it without you. It means so much to us. We wish you well through the stars, Captain <last>."|11757|0
units.english: Liam adds, "We will always be grateful for your help with our father's will. We never imagined that we would come so far, and we would have never done it without you. It means so much to us. We wish you well through the stars, Captain <last>."

units.italian: "Beh, va bene. Apprezzeremo sempre l'aiuto che ci hai dato nel realizzare il testamento di nostro padre. Ancora una volta i fratelli ti ringraziano profusamente per il viaggio, e li guardi lasciare lo spazioporto di Prime con eccitazione.
